question: Which users have the highest number of followers? Return the top 3 users ordered by follower count in descending order, and alphabetically by screen name in case of ties.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers_count IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name AS user, u.followers_count AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC, user ASC LIMIT 3

question: How many posted tweets consist of exactly one word that contains at least one hashtag ('#')?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE SIZE(SPLIT(t.text, ' ')) = 1 AND t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN COUNT(t) AS oneWordHashtagTweets

question: Which user screen name have more than 1000 followers but fewer than 500 friends?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers_count > 1000 AND u.friends_count < 500 RETURN u.screen_name AS user, u.followers_count AS followers, u.friends_count AS friends ORDER BY followers DESC

question: Retrieve the text, favorite count and retweet count of the tweets that have at least 50 favorites but fewer than 10 retweets.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorite_count >= 50 AND t.retweet_count < 10 RETURN t.text, t.favorite_count, t.retweet_count

question: List all user names that are a single word and contain at least one non-English letter
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(SPLIT(u.name, ' ')) = 1 AND u.name =~ '.*[À-žА-Яа-яء-ي].*' RETURN u.name

question: Find all user names that are exactly three words and contain at least one non-English letter
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(SPLIT(u.name, ' ')) = 3 AND u.name =~ '.*[À-žА-Яа-яء-ي].*' RETURN u.name

question: Return names of users that contain the Russian letter 'Д' at least once.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name CONTAINS 'Д' RETURN u.name

question: Which user names have a location that contains the word 'New'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'New' RETURN u.name, u.location

question: List the description and name of users that have a description containing the word 'minister'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description CONTAINS 'minister' RETURN u.description, u.name

question: List the names of users whose profile description contains 'GodBlessAmerica'. Also show the description.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description CONTAINS 'GodBlessAmerica' RETURN u.description, u.name

question: List screen name and user key of all users whose screen name contains their user key.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS u.user_key RETURN u.screen_name, u.user_key

question: Retrieve tweet texts that contain the word 'hate' and the smiling emoji (Unicode 😊).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hate' AND t.text CONTAINS '😊' RETURN t.text

question: Retrieve tweet texts that contain the word 'love' and a crying emoji (Unicode 😢 or 😥).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'love' AND (t.text CONTAINS '😢' OR t.text CONTAINS '😥') RETURN t.text

question: Retrieve the first 3 tweets ordered by creation date in ascending order, breaking ties alphabetically by tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN t.text ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.text ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which tweet texts contain the word 'Obama' and were posted on the third day of January 2016? Return also the creation string.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'Obama' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-01-03' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweet texts contain the word 'vote' and 'Hillary' and were posted in January 2016? Return the tweet texts and creation string.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'vote' AND t.text CONTAINS 'Hillary' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-01' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets were retweeted more than 10000 times and have a text length equal to 140? Return the tweet text and retweet count.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.retweet_count > 10000 AND SIZE(t.text) = 140 RETURN t.text, t.retweet_count

question: Which tweets have been created in the first three months of 2016 and contain the word 'breaking' ignoring case? Return the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'breaking' AND t.created_str >= '2016-01' AND t.created_str < '2016-04' RETURN t.text

question: List the retweet count, favorite count, and text of tweets whose retweet count is greater than favorite count and whose text contains 'hate America'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.retweet_count > t.favorite_count AND t.text CONTAINS 'hate America' RETURN t.text, t.retweet_count, t.favorite_count

question: Return the favorite count and text of the tweets with the highest 'favorite_count'. list the top 3 and order alphabetically by tweet text in case of ties
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN t.text, t.favorite_count ORDER BY t.favorite_count DESC, t.text ASC LIMIT 3

question: Find tweets whose text contains a hashtag ('#'), the words 'women' and 'right', and a URL (matching https?://) (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '#' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'women' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'right' AND t.text =~ '(?s).*https?://.*' RETURN t.text

question: Retrieve the tweets between 2016 and 2017 that mention 'tsunami' and return the text and creation string.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str >= '2016-01-01' AND t.created_str <= '2017-12-31' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'tsunami' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Retrieve the text of tweets with 'hate' or synonyms 'detest', 'loathe', 'dislike', 'abhor', 'revile', 'despise' (all case-insensitive) on the specific day '2016-10-10'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hate' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'detest' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'loathe' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'dislike' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'abhor' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'revile' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'despise') AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-10-10' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: For each day on '2016-10', how many hate or synonyms 'detest', 'loathe', 'dislike', 'abhor', 'revile', 'despise' (all case-insensitive) tweets have been posted?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016-10' AND ANY(word IN [ 'hate', 'detest', 'loathe', 'dislike', 'abhor', 'revile', 'despise' ] WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS word) RETURN SUBSTRING(t.created_str, 0, 10) AS day, COUNT(*) AS hateTweetsInDay ORDER BY day

question: For each month in 2016, how many 'hate' or synonyms 'detest', 'loathe', 'dislike', 'abhor', 'revile', 'despise' (all case-insensitive) tweets have been posted?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' AND ANY(word IN [ 'hate', 'detest', 'loathe', 'dislike', 'abhor', 'revile', 'despise' ] WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS word) RETURN SUBSTRING(t.created_str, 0, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS hateTweetsInMonth ORDER BY month

question: How many user accounts were created in Chicago in 2013? Return the count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'Chicago' AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2013' RETURN COUNT(*) AS chicagoAccounts2013

question: How many users from Chicago have more than 390 friends? Return screen names and their friends count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'Chicago' AND u.friends_count > 390 RETURN u.screen_name, u.friends_count

question: Return the average followers count for people from Chicago in the year 2014.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'Chicago' AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2014' RETURN AVG(u.followers_count) AS avgFollowersChicago2014

question: Return the minimum followers count for people from Chicago in the year 2014.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'Chicago' AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2014' RETURN MIN(u.followers_count) AS minFollowersChicago2014

question: Return the maximum followers count for users from Chicago in the year 2014.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'Chicago' AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2014' RETURN MAX(u.followers_count) AS maxFollowersChicago2014

question: For each year, how many tweets mention both '#education' and 'health' (both case-insensitive)?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS '#education' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'health' RETURN SUBSTRING(t.created_str, 0, 4) AS year, COUNT(*) AS educationHealthTweets ORDER BY year

question: What is the average retweet count of tweets mentioning '#health' ignoring case in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS '#health' RETURN AVG(t.retweet_count) AS avgRetweetsHealth2016

question: How many tweets in 2017 mention the word 'tsunami' ignoring case?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str STARTS WITH '2017' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'tsunami' RETURN COUNT(*) AS tsunamiTweets2017

question: Which tweets whose text contains the word 'trump' ignoring case were posted on February third of 2017?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2017-02-03' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text contains the phrase 'michelle obama' ignoring case were posted in June 2015?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'michelle obama' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2015-06' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text mentions 'barack obama' ignoring case were posted in 2015?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'barack obama' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2015' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text mentions 'biden' ignoring case were posted in January 2017?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'biden' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2017-01' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text mentions 'trump' and 'hate' both ignoring case were posted on '2016-11-08'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hate' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016-11-08' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text contains 'hillary clinton' ignoring case were posted in October 2016 and has more than 1000 retweets?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hillary clinton' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-10' AND t.retweet_count > 1000 RETURN t.text, t.retweet_count, t.created_str

question: Which tweets contain 'hillary clinton' ignoring case and a hashtag ('#') in December 2016? Return the tweet text and creation date.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hillary clinton' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-12' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text contains 'hillary clinton' ignoring case and a URL were posted on October 31 of 2016? URL means that the tweet text contains 'https?://' (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hillary clinton' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-10-31' AND t.text =~ '(?s).*https?://.*' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which users have Cyrillic characters in their profile name and have more than 1000 friends? Return their screen names and profile names
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name =~ '.*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' AND u.friends_count > 1000 RETURN u.screen_name, u.name

question: Which users have Arabic characters in their profile name? Return their screen names, profile names and location
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name =~ '.*[\u0600-\u06FF].*' RETURN u.screen_name, u.name, u.location

question: Return the number of each location that users with Cyrillic names come from
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name =~ '.*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' RETURN u.location, COUNT(*) AS usersWithCyrillicName

question: What is the average number of followers for users whose description contains Cyrillic characters (possibly spanning multiple lines)?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' RETURN AVG(u.followers_count) AS avgFollowersCyrillicDesc

question: Which user screen names have Cyrillic characters in their description and have their location written in Cyrillic  (possibly spanning multiple lines)?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' AND u.location =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' RETURN u.screen_name, u.location, u.description

question: Which user screen_name have Cyrillic characters in their description and have a location that explicitly mentions Russia (for example 'russia' ignoring case, 'Росс', or 'РФ') (possibly spanning multiple lines)?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' AND ( toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'russia' OR u.location CONTAINS 'Росс' OR u.location CONTAINS 'РФ' ) RETURN u.screen_name, u.location, u.description

question: What is the average favourites_count and followers_count of users with Cyrillic names?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name =~ '.*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' RETURN AVG(u.favourites_count) AS avgFavourites, AVG(u.followers_count) AS avgFollowers

question: Which users with more than 5000 followers have Cyrillic characters in their description and use the Russian language setting? Return their screen name, language and description (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' AND u.lang = 'ru' AND u.followers_count > 5000 RETURN u.screen_name, u.lang, u.description

question: Which users have Cyrillic characters in their description and were created in 2016? Return their screen name, creation date and description (possibly spanning multiple lines)
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2016' RETURN u.screen_name, u.created_at, u.description

question: Which users have Cyrillic characters in their description, use the English language setting, and have more than 400 friends? Return their screen name, language, friends count, and description (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s).*\p{IsCyrillic}.*' AND u.lang = 'en' AND u.friends_count > 400 RETURN u.screen_name, u.lang, u.friends_count, u.description

question: How many user accounts were created on a Monday?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at STARTS WITH 'Mon' RETURN COUNT(*) AS accountsCreatedOnMonday

question: How many user accounts were created in January?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at CONTAINS 'Jan' RETURN COUNT(*) AS accountsCreatedInJanuary

question: For users created in 2015, what is the average followers count for each language? Return the language and average of followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at CONTAINS '2015' AND u.lang IS NOT NULL RETURN u.lang AS lang, AVG(u.followers_count) AS avgFollowers ORDER BY lang

question: Which languages are used by users whose location contains 'USA', and how many users use each language?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location CONTAINS 'USA' AND u.lang IS NOT NULL RETURN u.lang AS lang, COUNT(*) AS usersPerLang ORDER BY usersPerLang DESC

question: What is the average followers count of users whose description contains the word 'politics' and whose language is Russian?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE toLower(u.description) CONTAINS 'politics' AND u.lang = 'ru' RETURN AVG(u.followers_count) AS avgFollowersPoliticsRu

question: Which users were created in 2014, have more than 500 followers, and have a location that mentions Russia? Return their screen name, creation date, followers count, and location.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at CONTAINS '2014' AND u.followers_count > 500 AND (toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'russia' OR u.location CONTAINS 'Росс' OR u.location CONTAINS 'РФ') RETURN u.screen_name, u.created_at, u.followers_count, u.location ORDER BY u.followers_count DESC

question: What is the average followers count of users whose description contains at least one of the words 'challenge', 'sadness', 'hope', or 'glory' (all case-insensitive)?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE ANY(word IN ['challenge','sadness','hope','glory'] WHERE toLower(u.description) CONTAINS word) RETURN AVG(u.followers_count) AS avgFollowersEmotionalDesc

question: How many users have descriptions that contain at least one of the pronouns 'I', 'me', 'my', or 'myself' (possibly spanning multiple lines)?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description =~ '(?s)(?i).*(\bI\b|\bme\b|\bmy\b|\bmyself\b).*' RETURN COUNT(*) AS usersWithPersonalPronouns

question: How many users have descriptions that do not contain any of the pronouns 'i', 'me', 'my', or 'myself'(all case-insensitive) (possibly spanning multiple lines)?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description IS NOT NULL AND NOT (toLower(u.description) =~ '(?s).*\b(i|me|my|myself)\b.*') RETURN COUNT(*) AS usersWithoutPersonalPronouns

question: Which tweets whose text mentions both 'trump' and 'russia' both ignoring case were posted in November 2016 with more than 5 retweets?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'russia' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' AND t.retweet_count > 5 RETURN t.text, t.created_str, t.retweet_count

question: Which tweets whose text mentions 'election' were posted in the first month of 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-01' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: What is the average retweet count of tweets that contain the hashtag ('#health') ignoring case and were posted in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS '#health' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' RETURN AVG(t.retweet_count) AS avgRetweetsHealth2016

question: Which tweets whose text contains the word 'love' were posted on 2016-12-25?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'love' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016-12-25' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: For tweets posted in 2016, what is the maximum favorite count among those that contain the word 'health' ignoring case?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'health' RETURN MAX(t.favorite_count) AS maxFavouritesHealth2016

question: Which tweets contain the phrase 'hillary clinton' ignoring case, were posted in December 2016, contain at least one hashtag and a URL? 'URL' means that the tweet contains 'https?://'? Return the text and creation string (possibly spanning multiple lines)
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hillary clinton' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-12' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' AND t.text =~ '(?s).*https?://.*' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text contains the phrase 'hillary clinton' and the word 'email' both ignoring case, were posted in November 2016, and contain at least one hashtag('#')?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hillary clinton' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'email' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text contains the phrase 'hillary clinton' and the word 'fbi' both ignoring case, were posted in November 2016, and contain at least one hashtag('#')?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hillary clinton' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'fbi' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which Russian-language users location containing 'Москва' have more than 500 friends? Return their screen name, location and friends count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.lang = 'ru' AND u.location CONTAINS 'Москва' AND u.friends_count > 500 RETURN u.screen_name, u.location, u.friends_count

question: Show users whose description is very short (10 characters or fewer) and whose language is English.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(u.description) <= 10 AND u.lang = 'en' RETURN u

question: Show the user key of users whose description is very long (140 characters or more) and whose followers count is at least 5000.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(u.description) >= 140 AND u.followers_count >= 5000 RETURN u.user_key

question: Find users whose description contains 'politics' and whose language is English (lang = 'en'), and return their name.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE toLower(u.description) CONTAINS 'politics' AND u.lang = 'en' RETURN u.name

question: Return the text and creation string of the tweets that mention 'Muhammad Ali' and at least one of the words 'legend', 'hero', 'great', 'rip', or 'sad' (all case-insensitive) and were posted in June 2016.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'muhammad ali' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-06' AND ANY(word IN ['legend','hero','great','rip','sad'] WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS word) RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Retrieve the text and creation string of the tweets that mention 'olympics' and at least one of the words 'gold', 'bronze', 'medal', or 'team' (all case-insensitive) and were posted in August 2016.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'olympics' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-08' AND ANY(word IN ['gold','bronze','medal','team'] WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS word) RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Retrieve the text and creation string of the tweets that mention 'earthquake' and 'help' (case-insensitive) and were posted in 2016.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'earthquake' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'help' RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Retrieve the text and creation string of the tweets that contain the words 'election', 'vote', and 'fraud' (all case-insensitive) and were posted in second half of November 2016.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'vote' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'fraud' AND t.created_str > '2016-11-15' AND t.created_str < '2016-11-30' RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text mentions both 'trump' and 'clinton', contain the word 'email' (all case-insensitive), were posted in November 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'clinton' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'email' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets contain the word 'election', at least one hashtag ('#'), a URL, and the word 'immigration' (both case-insensitive), and were posted in 2016? Here, 'URL' means that the tweet contains 'https?://' (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'immigration' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' AND t.text =~ '(?s).*https?://.*' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets mention 'olympics' and at least one of the words 'rio', 'gold', or 'medal' (all case-insensitive), and were posted in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'olympics' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' AND any(word IN ['rio','gold','medal'] WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS word) RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Retrieve the text and creation string of the tweets which mention 'oscars' and the word 'movie' (both case-insensitive) and were posted in February 2016.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'oscars' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'movie' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-02' RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Find the text and creation string of the tweets which mention 'black lives matter' and 'police' (both case-insensitive) and were posted in 2016.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'black lives matter' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'police' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Which tweets mention both 'gun control' and 'election' and were posted in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'gun control' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016' RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text mentions both 'immigration' and 'trump' (both case-insensitive) were posted in first 10 days of the november 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'immigration' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND t.created_str >= '2016-11-01' AND t.created_str <= '2016-11-10' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets mention both 'islam' and 'terror' (both case-insensitive) and were posted in November 2016? Return the text and creation details.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'islam' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'terror' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets whose text contains the phrase 'make america great again' were posted in November 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'make america great again' AND t.created_str STARTS WITH '2016-11' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Which tweets mention 'black lives matter' and the word 'shoot' (both case-insensitive), and were posted in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'black lives matter' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'shoot' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Find all tweets that mention 'black lives matter', contain a hashtag ('#'), include the word 'protest' (both case-insensitive), and were posted in 2016.

cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = 'Nairobi' AND u.followers_count >= 100 RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers_count

question: Show the screen name of the users whose time zone is exactly 'London'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = 'London' RETURN u.screen_name

question: Show statuses count and screen name of the users whose time zone is 'London' and who have posted at least 500 statuses.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = 'London' AND u.statuses_count >= 500 RETURN u.screen_name, u.statuses_count

question: Show users screen names whose time zone is 'Bern' and whose language is exactly 'de'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = 'Bern' AND u.lang = 'de' RETURN u.screen_name

question: Return the language and screen name of the users who have the 'Berlin' time zone.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = 'Berlin' RETURN u.screen_name, u.lang

question: Show sources that do not mention 'twitter' at all in the link.
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE NOT toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'twitter' RETURN s.name

question: Show the sources whose names suggest they are used to repost content from external websites by containing words such as 'feed', 'publish', or 'dlvr'
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.name CONTAINS 'feed' OR s.name CONTAINS 'publish' OR s.name CONTAINS 'dlvr' RETURN s.name

question: Find troll screen names whose profile description mentions news related terms 'media', 'press', 'journalist', 'reporting' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'media' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'press' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'journalist' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'report' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find trolls whose description mentions sports related terms 'sport', 'football', 'soccer', 'nba', 'tennis' (all case-insensitive).Return the screen name and the description.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'sport' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'football' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'soccer' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'nba' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'tennis' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen names whose description mentions business/economy terms 'business', 'economy', 'economic', 'finance', 'market', 'trade' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'business' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'economy' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'economic' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'finance' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'market' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'trade' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen names whose description mentions one of the following politics terms 'politic', 'government', 'election', 'policy', 'congress' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'politic' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'government' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'election' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'policy' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'congress' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen names whose description mentions one entertainment terms 'entertainment', 'movies', 'music', 'celebrity', 'tv', 'show' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'entertainment' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'movie' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'music' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'celebrity' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'tv' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'show' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen names whose description mentions one of these travel terms 'travel', 'trip', 'tourism', 'traveler', 'journey', 'vacation' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE ( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'travel' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'trip' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'tourism' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'traveler' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'journey' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'vacation' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen names whose description suggests opinion or commentary by including at least one of these keywords: 'opinion', 'commentary', 'thoughts', 'views', or 'analysis' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE ( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'opinion' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'commentary' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'thoughts' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'views' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'analysis' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen names whose description includes at least one business-related keyword 'business', 'economy', 'finance', 'market' and at least one politics-related keyword 'politic', 'government' , 'policy', 'election' (all case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'business' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'economy' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'finance' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'market' ) AND ( toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'politic' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'government' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'policy' OR toLower(tr.description) CONTAINS 'election' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description

question: Find troll screen name whose description mentions at least one of the 'entertainment', 'music', 'movie' and 'celebrity' terms and at least one of the 'opinion', 'commentary', 'analysis' and 'views' (all case-insensitive) terms.
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE ( toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'entertainment' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'music' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'movie' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'celebrity' ) AND ( toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'opinion' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'commentary' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'analysis' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'views' ) RETURN t.screen_name, t.description

question: Find trolls whose name contains a Roman numeral token (like II, IV, XVI...)
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE tr.name =~ '.*\b[IVXLCDM]{2,}\b.*' RETURN tr.name

question: Return the screen name of the users that start with 'A'(case insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name STARTS WITH 'A' or u.screen_name starts with 'a' RETURN u.screen_name

question: Find the User node with screen name 'Aleksey_Sokol_' and return its language and time zone.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'Aleksey_Sokol_'}) RETURN u.lang, u.time_zone

question: For the user with screen name Aleksey_Sokol_, show followers and friends and also indicate whether followers are greater than friends
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'Aleksey_Sokol_'}) RETURN u.followers_count, u.friends_count, (u.followers_count > u.friends_count) AS followers_greater_than_friends

question: Show users whose screen name contain 'Aleksey' only if their screen name also ends with an underscore and they have posted at least 1000 statuses (If yes also the number of statuses count).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'Aleksey' AND u.screen_name ENDS WITH '_' AND u.statuses_count >= 1000 RETURN u.screen_name, u.statuses_count

question: Show for user whose screen name is 'Aleksey_Sokol_' the account creation time and confirm whether it contains '2014'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'Aleksey_Sokol_'}) RETURN u.created_at, (u.created_at CONTAINS '2014') AS created_in_2014

question: For the user whose screen name is 'BlackEyeBlog', show followers and listed_count and indicate whether listed_count is at least 10.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'BlackEyeBlog'}) RETURN u.followers_count, u.listed_count, (u.listed_count >= 10) AS listed_at_least_10

question: Show the user whose screen name contains 'TaisiaAvdeeva' only if their name contains a space and their description is present (not NULL).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'TaisiaAvdeeva' AND u.name CONTAINS ' ' AND u.description IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name, u.name, u.description

question: For the user whose screen name is 'TaisiaAvdeeva', show the friends count, followers count and whether the user has more friends than followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'TaisiaAvdeeva'}) RETURN u.friends_count, u.followers_count, (u.friends_count > u.followers_count) AS friends_greater_than_followers

question: Show users whose screen name contains 'TaisiaAvdeeva' and whose time zone is one of the following: 'Moscow', 'St. Petersburg', or 'Volgograd'
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'TaisiaAvdeeva' AND u.time_zone IN ['Moscow', 'St. Petersburg', 'Volgograd'] RETURN u.screen_name, u.time_zone

question: Show users whose screen name contains 'Ritterrrr' and whose length of the screen name is at least 10.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'Ritterrrr' AND SIZE(u.screen_name) >= 10 RETURN u.screen_name, SIZE(u.screen_name) AS screen_name_len

question: For the user with screen name 'KateRitterrrr', show statuses and favourites and indicate whether favourites are at least double statuses.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'KateRitterrrr'}) RETURN u.statuses_count, u.favourites_count, (u.favourites_count >= 2 * u.statuses_count) AS favourites_at_least_double_statuses

question: Return the language of the user with screen name 'fischermaria933'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'fischermaria933'}) RETURN u.lang

question: Show users whose screen name contains 'LosAngeles' and also contains 'daily' (case-insensitive) and whose description contains 'news' (case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (u:User ) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'LosAngeles' AND toLower(u.screen_name) CONTAINS 'daily' AND toLower(u.description) CONTAINS 'news' RETURN u.screen_name, u.description

question: Show users whose screen name contains 'LosAngeles' and their location contains 'Los Angeles' (case-insensitive) and their language is exactly 'en'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'LosAngeles' AND toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'los angeles' AND u.lang = 'en' RETURN u.screen_name, u.location

question: For the user whose screen name is 'DailyLosAngeles', show whether listed count is greater than 0 and include the listed count value.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'DailyLosAngeles'}) RETURN u.listed_count, (u.listed_count > 0) AS listed_count_gt_0

question: Return the time zone and description of the user with screen name 'HamburgBote'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'HamburgBote'}) RETURN u.time_zone, u.description

question: Find the user with screen name containing the substring 'Vinkova', the name contains Cyrillic characters and the language is exactly 'ru'
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name CONTAINS 'Vinkova' AND u.name =~ '.*[А-Яа-я].*' AND u.lang = 'ru' RETURN u.screen_name, u.name, u.lang

question: Find User whose screen name contains 'Vinkova' and whose description includes at least one Cyrillic character (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) where u.screen_name CONTAINS 'Vinkova' AND u.description=~ '(?s).*[А-Яа-я].*' RETURN u.screen_name, u.description

question: For the user with screen name 'LysikVinkova', show whether followers count is at least 10 times friends count (only when both counts are present and friends count is greater than 0).
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'LysikVinkova'}) WHERE u.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND u.friends_count IS NOT NULL AND u.friends_count > 0 RETURN u.followers_count, u.friends_count, (u.followers_count >= 10 * u.friends_count) AS followers_ge_10x_friends

question: For the user whose screen name is '_NickLuna_', show created_at and confirm whether the created_at string contains 'May'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: '_NickLuna_'}) RETURN u.created_at, (u.created_at CONTAINS ' May ') AS created_in_may

question: Show screen name and real name of users that are exactly the same string.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name = u.name RETURN u.screen_name, u.name

question: Show users whose profile description mentions their own screen name.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE toLower(u.description) CONTAINS toLower(u.screen_name) RETURN u.screen_name, u.description

question: Show screen name of users whose screen name appears to be autogenerated (contains both letters and digits and ends with digits)
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name =~ '.*[A-Za-z].*[0-9]+$' RETURN u.screen_name

question: Show screen name, name and created_at value of users whose name contains more words than their screen name in October (Oct) 2014.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(SPLIT(u.name, ' ')) > SIZE(SPLIT(u.screen_name, ' ')) AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2014' AND u.created_at CONTAINS 'Oct' RETURN u.screen_name, u.name, u.created_at

question: Show screen name, description length of users whose description is longer than 13 times their screen name length.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(u.description) > 13 * SIZE(u.screen_name) RETURN u.screen_name, SIZE(u.description) AS description_len

question: Show screen name, friends count and followers count of users whose friends are 10 times more than their followers (friends ≥ 10 × followers).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers_count > 0 AND u.friends_count >= 10 * u.followers_count RETURN u.screen_name, u.friends_count, u.followers_count

question: Show screen names and favourites counts of the users that their screen name contains 'Y' whose favourites count is higher than both followers and friends combined.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.favourites_count > (u.followers_count + u.friends_count) AND u.screen_name CONTAINS 'Y' RETURN u.screen_name, u.favourites_count

question: Show users who post a lot but have very low engagement(statuses ≥ 10,000 and followers ≤ 100).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.statuses_count >= 10000 AND u.followers_count <= 100 RETURN u.screen_name, u.statuses_count, u.followers_count

question: Show users whose time_zone and location are inconsistent (Moscow without 'russia' ignoring case in location, or London without 'uk' ignoring case in location).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE ( (u.time_zone CONTAINS 'Moscow' AND NOT toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'russia') OR (u.time_zone CONTAINS 'London' AND NOT toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'uk') ) RETURN u.screen_name, u.time_zone, u.location

question: Show screen name and name of the users whose language is English but whose name contains non-Latin characters
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.lang = 'en' AND u.name =~ '.*[А-Яа-яء-ي].*' RETURN u.screen_name, u.name

question: Show users whose created_at string contains a weekday abbreviation and the year '2009'
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at =~ '.*(Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun).*2009.*' AND u.created_at CONTAINS '2009' RETURN u.screen_name, u.created_at

question: Show users whose time zone is empty but whose location is specified.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = '' AND u.location IS NOT NULL AND u.location <> '' RETURN u.screen_name, u.location

question: Show screen name and description of the trolls whose screen name suggests a news outlet but whose description does not mention 'news' or 'media' both ignoring case.
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE toLower(t.screen_name) CONTAINS 'news' AND NOT ( toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'news' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'media' ) RETURN t.screen_name, t.description

question: Show trolls whose account created_at value contains Sunday ('Sun') of a year but whose description is empty
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.created_at =~ '.*[0-9]{4}.*' AND t.created_at CONTAINS 'Sun' AND (t.description IS NULL OR t.description = '') RETURN t.screen_name, t.created_at

question: Return id, favorite count and retweet count of tweets whose favorite count is 20 times higher compared to retweets (likes ≥ 20 × retweets).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.retweet_count > 0 AND t.favorite_count >= 20 * t.retweet_count RETURN t.id, t.favorite_count, t.retweet_count

question: Show hashtags that mix letters and digits and contain underscore
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag =~ '.*[A-Za-z].*' AND h.tag =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND h.tag CONTAINS '_' RETURN h.tag

question: Show screen name and description of users whose description contains more than one exclamation mark('!') (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description IS NOT NULL AND u.description =~ '(?s).*!.*!.*' RETURN u.screen_name, u.description

question: Show screen name and description of trolls whose description is entirely lowercase letters in '2011' (ignoring spaces).
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.description = toLower(t.description) AND t.created_at CONTAINS '2011' RETURN t.screen_name, t.description

question: Show the screen name and created_at value of trolls whose account created_at value contains Monday ('Mon').
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE (t.created_at CONTAINS 'Mon' ) RETURN t.screen_name, t.created_at

question: Show screen name, followers count and friends count of users who have more than 100 followers but follow fewer than 100 accounts.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers_count > 100 AND u.friends_count < 100 RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers_count, u.friends_count

question: Show screen name, followers count and friends count of trolls who have more than 500 favourites but fewer than 20 friends.
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.favourites_count > 500 AND t.friends_count < 20 RETURN t.screen_name, t.favourites_count, t.friends_count

question: List the IDs of tweets whose text contains a link to twitter (the substring https://twitter.com).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'https://twitter.com' RETURN t.id

question: How many tweets contain the word 'Twitter' at least twice (case-insensitive) (possibly spanning multiple lines)?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '(?s)(?i).*twitter.*twitter.*' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: How many sources have a name that starts with an HTML anchor tag linking to 'http://twitter.com'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.name CONTAINS 'http://twitter.com' AND s.name STARTS WITH '<a' RETURN COUNT(s) AS twitter_client_source_count

question: List the names of sources that use the Buffer publishing platform.
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.name CONTAINS 'Buffer' RETURN s.name

question: List name of sources whose name contains a Russian domain (.ru).
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.name CONTAINS '.ru' RETURN s.name

question: List sources whose name contains an Italian domain (.it).
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.name CONTAINS '.it' RETURN s.name

question: List hashtags that start with the word 'american' but do not contain the word 'africa'.
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag STARTS WITH 'american' AND NOT h.tag CONTAINS 'africa' RETURN h.tag

question: List hashtags that contain the word 'sport'.
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'sport' RETURN h.tag

question: List hashtags that contain the word 'sport' and also contain either 'team' or 'center'.
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'sport' AND (h.tag CONTAINS 'team' OR h.tag CONTAINS 'center') RETURN h.tag

question: List hashtags that mention 'election' and '2016' but do not mention sports.
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) WHERE (h.tag CONTAINS '2016' AND h.tag CONTAINS 'election') AND NOT h.tag CONTAINS 'sport' RETURN h.tag

question: Return the screen name, location and friends count of the users whose location contains 'russia' and have more than 300 friends.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'russia' AND u.friends_count > 300 RETURN u.screen_name, u.location, u.friends_count

question: Compare total users vs distinct user key values (to see if user key behaves like a unique identifier).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN COUNT(u) AS total_users, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_key) AS distinct_user_key_count

question: Return the screen name and id and user_key of users whose id is longer that 5 characters.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(u.id) > 5 RETURN u.screen_name, u.id, u.user_key

question: Return the maximum length of the user key.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN MAX(SIZE(u.user_key))

question: List tweet id where creation string exists but created at timestamp is missing.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at IS NULL RETURN t.id, t.created_str

question: Return the id of users whose id length is greater than 15 characters.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(u.id) > 15 RETURN u.id

question: Return the id of users whose id length is greater than 17 and whose id contains only digits.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE SIZE(u.id) > 17 AND u.id =~ '^[0-9]+$' RETURN u.id

question: Return the user key and id for users whose user key contains at least one letter and whose id is longer than 17 digits
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.user_key =~ '.*[A-Za-z].*' AND SIZE(u.id) > 17 RETURN u.id, u.user_key

question: List tweets that are not marked as retweeted but have more than 10000 retweet.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.retweeted = false AND t.retweet_count > 10000 RETURN t.id, t.retweet_count

question: List tweet id whose id starts with '71' and text starts with 'RT ' (retweet-style text) and retweeted is false. Return id, retweeted and text.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text IS NOT NULL AND t.text <> '' AND t.text STARTS WITH 'RT ' AND t.retweeted = false AND t.id STARTS WITH '71' RETURN t.id, t.retweeted, t.text

question: List tweet id whose text ends with '?' and have at least 5 retweets. Return id, retweet count and text.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text IS NOT NULL AND t.text <> '' AND t.text ENDS WITH '?' AND t.retweet_count IS NOT NULL AND t.retweet_count >= 5 RETURN t.id, t.retweet_count, t.text

question: List tweet id, favorite count and text of whose text contains both 'http' and '#' and has at least 10000 like.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text IS NOT NULL AND t.text <> '' AND t.text CONTAINS 'http' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' AND t.favorite_count >= 10000 RETURN t.id, t.favorite_count, t.text

question: List tweets whose text contains a dollar sign '$' and contains at least one digit and the id starts with '800'. Return id and text (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text IS NOT NULL AND t.text <> '' AND t.text CONTAINS '$' AND t.text =~ '(?s).*[0-9].*' AND t.id STARTS WITH '800' RETURN t.id, t.text

question: List tweets whose text contains both '!' and '?' and has more likes than retweets and retweet count greater than 50.Return the id, favorite count and retweet count.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '!' AND t.text CONTAINS '?' AND t.favorite_count > t.retweet_count AND t.retweet_count >50 RETURN t.id, t.favorite_count, t.retweet_count

question: List tweets whose text contains '...' (three dots),at least one hashtag ('#') and ends with a question mark.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '...' AND t.text ENDS WITH '?' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN t.id, t.text

question: Return the id and text of the tweets that contain 'youtube' and 'google'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'youtube' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'google' RETURN t.id, t.text

question: List tweets whose text contains a percentage sign '%' and has at least 1000 retweet.Return the id , retweet count and the text of the tweet.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '%' AND t.retweet_count >= 1000 RETURN t.id, t.retweet_count, t.text

question: List tweets whose text contains the word 'poll' (case-insensitive) and ends with '?'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'poll' AND t.text ENDS WITH '?' RETURN t.id, t.text

question: List users whose user key is digits-only but is not exactly 4 digits long. Return the user key.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.user_key =~ '^[0-9]+$' AND NOT u.user_key =~ '^[0-9]{4}$' RETURN u.user_key

question: List users whose screen name starts with 'A' and whose id length is greater than 17.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name IS NOT NULL AND u.screen_name <> '' AND u.screen_name STARTS WITH 'A' AND SIZE(u.id) > 17 RETURN u.screen_name, u.id

question: List screen name and description of the users whose description contains an email-like '@' and '.com'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description CONTAINS '@' AND u.description CONTAINS '.com' RETURN u.screen_name, u.description

question: List users whose followers count is at least 1000 and whose listed count is 0. Return the screen name, followers count and listed count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers_count >= 1000 AND u.listed_count = 0 RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers_count, u.listed_count

question: Return the maximum length of user descriptions among users with non-empty descriptions.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description IS NOT NULL AND u.description <> '' RETURN MAX(SIZE(u.description)) AS max_user_description_length

question: Return the minimum length of user screen names among users with non-empty screen names.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name IS NOT NULL AND u.screen_name <> '' RETURN MIN(SIZE(u.screen_name)) AS min_screen_name_length

question: Count how many users have an empty time zone string.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.time_zone = '' or u.time_zone IS NULL RETURN COUNT(u) AS user_count_empty_time_zone

question: Count how many users are missing description (NULL or empty).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description IS NULL OR u.description = '' RETURN COUNT(u) AS user_count_missing_description

question: List users whose created_at value contains 'Mon' and who have a non-empty location.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at CONTAINS 'Mon' AND u.location IS NOT NULL AND u.location <> '' RETURN u.screen_name, u.created_at, u.location

question: Return the screen name and user key of the users whose screen name ends with an underscore ('_') and whose user key contains a letter
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name ENDS WITH '_' AND u.user_key =~ '.*[A-Za-z].*' RETURN u.screen_name, u.user_key

question: List users whose user key equals their screen name ignoring case and is created in September 'Sep'.Return the screen name, user key and created at.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE toLower(u.user_key) = toLower(u.screen_name) AND u.created_at CONTAINS ' Sep ' RETURN u.screen_name, u.user_key, u.created_at

question: List trolls whose time zone is 'London' and whose description contains 'news' (case-insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.time_zone = 'London' AND toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'news' RETURN t.screen_name, t.time_zone, t.description

question: List trolls whose description starts with an uppercase letter and is at least 130 characters long.Return the screen name, description length (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.description =~ '(?s)^[A-Z].*' AND SIZE(t.description) >= 130 RETURN t.screen_name, SIZE(t.description) AS description_len

question: Return screen name and description of the trolls whose both contain 'news'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'news' AND toLower(t.screen_name) CONTAINS 'news' RETURN t.screen_name, t.name, t.description

question: List trolls whose screen name contains 'news', and whose description contains 'business' OR 'economy'(case insensitive).
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE toLower(t.screen_name) CONTAINS 'news' AND (toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'business' OR toLower(t.description) CONTAINS 'economy') RETURN t.screen_name, t.description

question: Show tweet text and creation string for tweets that start with '@' and contain the word 'black' ignoring case, but do not contain a hashtag('#').
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text STARTS WITH '@' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'black' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Count tweets that mention '@Today' and also contain the word 'news' or 'report' ignoring case.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '@Today' AND (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'news' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'report') RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Show tweet text for tweets that mention '@Today' and 'city' (case insensitive) but do not contain the substring 'http'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '@Today' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'city' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS 'http' RETURN t.text

question: Show tweet text and creation string for tweets that contain '#Truth' and is created in 2017 but do not contain 'Russia' or 'Ukraine'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '#Truth' AND NOT (t.text CONTAINS 'Russia' OR t.text CONTAINS 'Ukraine') AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2017' RETURN t.text, t.created_str

question: Show tweet text for tweets that contain '#Truth' and contain either 'media' or 'news', but do not contain 'fake' (all case-insensitive).

question: Count tweets that contain '#Truth' but contain neither a mention ('@') nor a link (http).

question: Count tweets that start with 'RT @' and contain a dollar sign ($), but do not contain the substring 'http'.

question: Return the minimum hashtag length.
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag IS NOT NULL RETURN MIN(SIZE(h.tag)) AS min_hashtag_len

question: Return the maximum hashtag length.
cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag) RETURN MAX(SIZE(h.tag)) AS max_hashtag_length

question: Count tweets whose text contains exactly two question marks.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '^[^?]*\?[^?]*\?[^?]*$' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Return the text of tweets whose text starts with a lowercase letter and ends with a period (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text IS NOT NULL AND t.text =~ '(?s)^[a-z].*\.$' RETURN t.text

question: Count tweets where the number of likes is at least twice the number of retweets.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorite_count >= 2 * t.retweet_count RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Count tweets whose text contains parentheses( '(' , ')' ) but no hashtags('#').
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '(' AND t.text CONTAINS ')' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS '#' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Count tweets whose text contains a colon (':') but does not contain a URL(http).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS ':' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS 'http' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Count tweets that contain at least one digit and at least one emoji-like Unicode character('.*[\u2600-\u27BF].*') (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '(?s).*[0-9].*' AND t.text =~ '.*[\u2600-\u27BF].*' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Count tweets whose text contains a quoted phrase (double quotes) (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '(?s).*"[^"]+".*' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Count tweets whose text contains more commas (,) than periods (.).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE SIZE(SPLIT(t.text, ',')) > SIZE(SPLIT(t.text, '.')) RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Count tweets created in 2016 whose text contains no alphabetic characters (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str CONTAINS '2016' AND NOT t.text =~ '(?s).*[A-Za-z].*' RETURN COUNT(t) AS tweet_count

question: Return the text of the tweets whose text contains a dash ('-') but does not contain a space.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '-' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS ' ' RETURN t.text

question: Count users whose screen name contains digits but whose name contains no digits
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND u.name IS NOT NULL AND NOT u.name =~ '.*[0-9].*' RETURN COUNT(u) AS user_count

question: Return the name and description of users whose description contains parentheses( '(' , ')' ) and whose location is missing.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description CONTAINS '(' AND u.description CONTAINS ')' AND (u.location IS NULL OR u.location = '') RETURN u.name,u.description

question: Return the screen name of users whose screen name is entirely uppercase.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name = toUpper(u.screen_name) RETURN u.screen_name

question: Return the screen name and description of the users whose description ends with an exclamation mark.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.description ENDS WITH '!' RETURN u.screen_name, u.description

question: Return the description of users whose language is English and whose description does not contain any vowels.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.lang = 'en' AND u.description =~ '^[^aeiouAEIOU]+$' RETURN u.description

question: Return the user key of the users whose account creation year is 2014 and whose description is missing.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.created_at CONTAINS '2014' AND (u.description IS NULL OR u.description = '') RETURN u.user_key

question: Count users whose favourites count is greater than their statuses count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.favourites_count > u.statuses_count RETURN COUNT(u) AS user_count

question: Count users whose screen name contains exactly one underscore.

question: Return the name and description of trolls whose description contains both a colon and a dash.

question: Return the name of trolls whose followers count is zero but statuses count is greater than zero.

question: Return the screen name of the trolls whose screen name starts with a digit

question: Return the description of the trolls whose description contains uppercase words of length at least 5 (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.description =~ '(?s).*\b[A-Z]{5,}\b.*' RETURN t.description

question: Return the name, friends count and followers count of trolls whose friends count is at least 10 times their followers count (and they are not 0).
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.followers_count > 0 AND t.friends_count > 0 AND t.friends_count >= 10 * t.followers_count RETURN t.name ,t.friends_count,t.followers_count

question: Count URLs whose expanded URL ends with a numeric identifier
cypher: MATCH (u:URL) WHERE u.expanded_url =~ '.*[0-9]$' RETURN COUNT(u) AS url_count

question: Return source names that contain HTML tags but do not contain the word 'Twitter'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.name CONTAINS '<' AND s.name CONTAINS '>' AND NOT s.name CONTAINS 'Twitter' RETURN s.name

question: Show tweet IDs and text where the tweet contains both parentheses ('(' , ')' ), a question mark('?'),excalamation mark('!') and comma(',').
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '(' AND t.text CONTAINS ')' AND t.text CONTAINS '?' AND t.text CONTAINS '!' AND t.text CONTAINS ',' RETURN t.id, t.text

question: Show tweet texts and creation strings that start with a lowercase letter and contain a hashtag and creation string is after June 2017 (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '(?s)^[a-z].*' AND t.text CONTAINS '#' AND t.created_str > '2017-06' RETURN t.text,t.created_str

question: Show tweet texts, IDs and creation strings for tweets created on November 2016 whose text contains no digits and no space (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' AND t.text IS NOT NULL AND NOT t.text =~ '(?s).*[0-9].*' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS ' ' RETURN t.id, t.created_str, t.text

question: Show the IDs and text of tweets whose text does not contain a URL ('http'), does not contain any spaces and whose text length is greater than 2 characters and less than 5 characters.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE NOT t.text CONTAINS 'http' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS ' ' AND SIZE(t.text)<5 AND SIZE(t.text)>2 RETURN t.id,t.text

question: Show tweets whose text contains both a dollar sign and a percentage sign.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '$' AND t.text CONTAINS '%' RETURN t.text

question: Show tweet texts and IDs whose text contains both uppercase and lowercase letters and whose text lenght is less than 5 characters (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE SIZE(t.text ) < 5 AND t.text =~ '(?s).*[A-Z].*' AND t.text =~ '(?s).*[a-z].*' RETURN t.id, t.text

question: Show tweets whose text contains a hyphen ('-') but no spaces.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '-' AND NOT t.text CONTAINS ' ' RETURN t.text

question: Show users whose screen name starts and ends with a digit
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name =~ '^[0-9].*[0-9]$' RETURN u.screen_name

question: Show screen name, followers count and friends count of users whose followers count is greater than friends count by at least 10000. Both followers count and friends count must be greater than 0.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers_count > 0 AND u.friends_count > 0 AND u.followers_count >= u.friends_count + 10000 RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers_count, u.friends_count

question: Show tweets whose text starts with a lowercase letter, contains exactly one hashtag, and ends with a question mark (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '(?s)^[a-z].*' AND t.text =~ '^[^#]*#[^#]*$' AND t.text ENDS WITH '?' RETURN t.text

question: Show tweets whose text contains a quoted phrase written entirely in uppercase letters (without crossing line breaks).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '.*\"[A-Z ]+\".*' AND NOT t.text STARTS WITH 'RT' RETURN DISTINCT t.text

question: Show screen name and name of users whose name contains exactly two words, the language is not English ('en') and has followers count more than 5000.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.name =~ '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+$' AND NOT u.lang = 'en' AND u.followers_count > 5000 RETURN u.screen_name, u.name

question: Show screen name and description of trolls whose description contains exactly one exclamation mark.
cypher: MATCH (t:Troll) WHERE t.description =~ '^[^!]*![^!]*$' RETURN t.screen_name, t.description

question: Show users whose screen name starts with 'mr' (case-insensitive).

question: What is the maximum length of any user screen name in the dataset?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN MAX(SIZE(u.screen_name)) AS max_screen_name_len

question: What is the maximum length of any troll screen name in the dataset?

question: What is the maximum length of any tweet text?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN MAX(SIZE(t.text)) AS max_tweet_text_len

question: Show the top 5 trolls ranked by the highest number of posted statuses breaking ties alphabetically by screen_name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE tr.statuses_count IS NOT NULL RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.statuses_count ORDER BY tr.statuses_count DESC, tr.screen_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Show the top 5 trolls ranked by the highest followers count, breaking ties alphabetically by screen name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll) WHERE tr.followers_count IS NOT NULL RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.followers_count ORDER BY tr.followers_count DESC, tr.screen_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Show screen name and status count of users whose favourites count is 0, but whose statuses count is at least 500.

question: Return the text of the tweet with max tweet length (191)

question: Show creation string and text of tweets whose text contains the same word repeated twice consecutively (e.g., 'very very') and have creation sting after '2017-06' (possibly spanning multiple lines).

question: Show text of tweets whose contains exactly three words and has retweet count more than 50.

question: Show tweets whose text contains a word longer than 40 characters (possibly spanning multiple lines).

question: Show tweets whose text contains only one unique character repeated (possibly spanning multiple lines).

question: Show users whose screen name contains only consonants and digits.

question: Show screen name and name of users whose name and screen name have the same length.

question: Show hashtags whose tag contains exactly one underscore.

question: Show screen name and name of trolls whose name consists of exactly one word and the language is English 'en' .

question: Show screen name and description of trolls whose description contains a colon (':') separating two clauses (possibly spanning multiple lines).

question: Show users whose screen name contains exactly three digits in total.

question: Show users whose screen name starts with a digit and contains letters

question: Show users whose description contains exactly one sentence (possibly spanning multiple lines).

question: Show users whose screen name contains a repeated character three times in a row

question: Show users whose name and screen name share the same first letter, whose account was created in 2015, and whose description is present. Return the name, screen name and created at.

question: Show users whose name contains exactly two words, whose screen name contains digits, and whose favourites count is zero.Show the screen name and name

question: Which users with non-empty names have a non-empty location (ignoring whitespace) but a missing or empty time zone?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.location IS NOT NULL AND (u.location) <> '' AND (u.time_zone IS NULL OR (u.time_zone) = '') AND u.name <>'' RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which users posted tweets and have lang set to German ('de') and an empty (or missing) location? Return the distinct user names.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.lang = 'de' AND (u.location IS NULL OR (u.location) = '') RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have lang set to English ('en') and more than 50000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.lang = 'en' AND u.followers_count > 50000 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.followers_count

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have followers but no favourites?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.followers_count > 0 AND u.favourites_count = 0 RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which users posted tweets and have screen name starting with 'c' and equal to their user key?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.screen_name = u.user_key AND u.screen_name STARTS WITH 'c' RETURN DISTINCT u.screen_name

question: Which users posted tweets where the tweet text contains '@' and more than 999 favorites? Return the user key and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorite_count > 999 AND t.text CONTAINS '@' RETURN u.user_key, t.text

question: Which users posted tweets where the tweet text contains 'RT ' and more than 999 favorites? Return the user key and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorite_count > 999 AND t.text CONTAINS 'RT ' RETURN u.user_key, t.text

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have time zone containing 'Berlin'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.time_zone CONTAINS 'Berlin' RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.time_zone

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have time zone = 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)', lang = 'en', and more than 2000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.time_zone = 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)' AND u.lang = 'en' AND u.followers_count > 2000 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.followers_count

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have time zone = 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)', lang = 'en', and location contains either 'America' or 'USA'? Return their name.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.time_zone = 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)' AND u.lang = 'en' AND ( u.location CONTAINS 'America' OR u.location CONTAINS 'USA' ) RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have time zone containing 'US & Canada' and listed more than 200 times?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.time_zone CONTAINS 'US & Canada' AND u.listed_count > 200 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.time_zone, u.listed_count

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have time zone containing 'US & Canada', less than 20 followers, and more than 20 statuses?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.time_zone CONTAINS 'US & Canada' AND u.followers_count < 20 AND u.statuses_count > 20 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.time_zone, u.followers_count, u.statuses_count

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have time zone 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)' and location contains 'NY' or 'new york' (case-insensitive) and more than 1000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE u.time_zone = 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)' AND (u.location CONTAINS ' NY' OR toLower(u.location) CONTAINS 'new york') AND u.followers_count > 1000 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.location, u.followers_count

question: Which distinct user names posted tweets and have empty location and no time zone , and more than 3000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE (u.location IS NULL OR (u.location) = '') AND u.time_zone IS NOT NULL AND (u.time_zone) <> '' AND u.followers_count > 3000 RETURN DISTINCT u.name, u.followers_count

question: Which users posted tweets and have empty description, more than 100 followers, and listed equal to 0 times? Return their distinct name.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(:Tweet) WHERE (u.description IS NULL OR (u.description) = '') AND u.followers_count > 100 AND u.listed_count = 0 RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which users posted tweets with created string containing '2015', containing 'http', and more than 500 retweet? Return the name of user and text of tweet.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_str CONTAINS '2015' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'http' AND t.retweet_count > 500 RETURN u.name, t.text

question: Which users posted tweets containing a link ('http') and the hashtag '#Foke',created in November 2016, whose time zone is 'Jakarta', language is Indonesian ('id'), and location is exactly 'Amerika'? Return also the tweet text.

question: Return the top 10 languages used by users to post tweets, along with the number of tweets for each language, ordered by tweet count in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) RETURN u.lang AS language, COUNT(t) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which tweets created in November 2016 were posted by users whose location is 'Amerika' and who are not verified? Return also the user name.

question: Which tweet texts longer than 160 characters were posted by users with an empty description and a non-empty time zone? Return also the user name.

question: Which tweet texts containing an exclamation mark ('!') and more than 10 retweet were posted by users with less than 10 friends? Return also the user name.

question: Which tweet texts created in 2016 were posted by users created in 2016, with more than 12000 followers? Return also the user name.

question: Which tweets containing 'Trump' with more than 1000 retweet were posted by users with more than followers 500? Return also the user name.

question: Which tweet text mention 'epstein' but do not mention 'trump' (both case-insensitive), and were posted by users whose location does not contain 'USA' or 'America'? Return also the user name.

question: Which troll names posted tweets containing 'epstein' (case-insensitive) in the text with greater than 25 times listed?

question: Which troll screen names posted tweets containing a link ('http') (case-insensitive) and a question mark ('?') with favorite count more than 800?

question: Which troll names posted tweets between '2016-11' and '2016-12',when the language is English 'en', from time zone 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)', containing both 'trump' and 'russia' (both case-insensitive)? Return also the tweet text.

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing the same keyword 'rigged' (case-insensitive) on 7 November of 2016? Return the text of the tweet along with troll name.

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing both 'corrupt' and 'system' (both case-insensitive) during the November of 2016? Return the troll name and text of the tweets.

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing the phrase 'this proves' (case-insensitive) during an election period (2016)? Return the text of the tweets and the name of troll.

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing emotionally charged words like 'disaster' or 'traitor' (both case-insensitive) with higher than 500 retweets? Return the troll screen name and text of the tweet.

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing 'ashamed' or 'pathetic' (both case-insensitive) with exclamation marks ('!') ? Return the troll name and text of the tweet.

question: Which trolls posted tweets framed around fear using words like 'danger' and 'threat' (both case-insensitive) and included a link ('http') (case-insensitive)? Return the text of the tweet and the troll screen name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'danger' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'threat') AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'http' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets using absolute language such as 'everyone knows' or 'no one believes' (both case-insensitive)? Return the text of the tweet and the troll name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'everyone knows' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'no one believes' RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets claiming phrases like 'everything' and 'corrupt' (both case-insensitive)? Return the text of the tweet and the troll screen name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'everything' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'corrupt' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted short, punchy tweets (less than 80 characters) with high retweets (more than 500)? Return the text of the tweet and the troll screen name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE SIZE(t.text) < 80 AND t.retweet_count > 500 RETURN tr.screen_name, t.text

question: Which trolls with more than 120 listings posted tweets whose text contains emotionally charged words such as 'angry', 'furious', or 'terrified' (all case-insensitive) and at least one number? Return the troll name and the tweet text (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'angry' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'furious' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'terrified') AND tr.listed_count >120 AND t.text =~ '(?s).*[0-9].*' RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing trending political hashtags such as '#Election' or '#MAGA' with higher than 1000 retweets? Return the text of the tweet and the troll screen name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (t.text CONTAINS '#Election' OR t.text CONTAINS '#MAGA') AND t.retweet_count > 1000 RETURN tr.screen_name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing direct insults like 'idiot' and 'liar' (both case-insensitive) and containing both a question mark ('?') and an exclamation mark ('!')? Return the text of the tweet and the troll screen name.

question: Which trolls with more than 3000 friends and more than 3000 followers posted tweets that use mockery terms such as 'lol' or 'lmao' and also reference political topics like 'Trump' or the 'election'(all case-insensitive)? Return the troll name and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'lol' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'lmao') AND (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election') AND tr.friends_count > 3000 AND tr.followers_count > 3000 RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets dismissing dissent using phrases like 'you people' or 'typical of you' (both case-insensitive)? Return the text of the tweets and troll name.
