question: Which trolls with high number of list (more than 500) and high amount of followers (more than 8000) posted tweets containing urgency cues such as 'now', 'urgent', or 'must' (all case-insensitive), together with an external link 'http'? Return the text of the tweets and troll name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'urgent' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'must' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'now') AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'http' AND tr.listed_count > 500 AND tr.followers_count > 8000 RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls with many friends and followers (more than 3000 ) posted tweets containing ridicule markers like 'haha' or 'pathetic' (both case-insensitive) together with an exclamation mark ('!')? Return the text of the tweets and troll name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'haha' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'pathetic') AND t.text CONTAINS '!' AND tr.friends_count > 3000 AND tr.followers_count > 3000 RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing numbers and authority framing such as 'experts', 'studies', or 'reports' (all case-insensitive), while having a high listed count (more than 150)? Return the troll name and the tweet text (possibly spanning multiple lines).
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.text =~ '(?s).*[0-9].*' AND (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'experts' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'studies' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'reports') AND tr.listed_count > 150 RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets suggesting social consensus using phrases like 'everyone agrees' or 'people know' (both case-insensitive), while having high number of followers (more than 3000) ? Return the text of the tweets and troll name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'everyone agrees' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'people know') AND tr.followers_count > 3000 RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets containing group labels like 'they' or 'them' together with emotionally negative language, like 'dangerous' or 'corrupt' (all case-insensitive) while having high number of friends (more than 3000)? Return the text of the tweets and troll name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'they' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'them') AND (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'dangerous' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'corrupt') AND tr.friends_count > 3000 RETURN tr.name, t.text

question: Which tweets posted by the trolls 'LILJordamn', 'PaulineTT', 'RamonasNails', and 'JeffreyKahunas' during the same year (2016) contain the word 'corrupt' (case-insensitive) and have greater than 200 retweet? Return the troll retweet number, text and creation string of the tweet.

question: Which tweets posted between October 5 and 7 were short(less than 80 characters) , punchy, and highly retweeted (more than 200)? Return the screen name of the troll, text and number of retweets.

question: Which tweets posted by trolls with the screen names 'AmelieBaldwin' or 'hyddrox' between October 5 and 7 use hashtags or phrases suggesting a rigged system (e.g., “'riggedelection', 'rigged', 'fixed' all case-insensitive)? cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS '!' AND NOT t2.text CONTAINS '!' AND t2.text IS NOT NULL AND t2.text <> '' RETURN t1.text, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets contain repeated punctuation such as '!!!' or '???'? (possibly spanning multiple lines)
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(:Tweet) WHERE t1.text =~ '(?s).*[!?]{3,}.*' RETURN t1.text

question: Which reply tweets negate the tweets they reply to by containing 'never' or 'wrong' ignoring-case?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'never' OR toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'wrong' RETURN t1.text

question: Which reply tweets are longer than the tweets they reply to but have fewer favorites?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE SIZE(t1.text) > SIZE(t2.text) AND t1.favorite_count < t2.favorite_count RETURN t1.text, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets and the tweets they reply to both contain at least one numeric digit (without crossing line breaks)?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE t2.text =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND t1.text =~ '.*[0-9].*' RETURN t1.text, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets contain 'trump' (case-insensitive) and reply to tweets containing 'obama' (case-insensitive) ?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'obama' RETURN t1.text, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets contain 'trump' (case-insensitive) and reply to tweets containing 'clinton' (case-insensitive) ?

question: Which reply tweets contain 'trump' (case-insensitive) and reply to tweets containing 'clinton' (case-insensitive), where the original tweet has at least one retweet?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'clinton' AND t2.retweet_count > 0 RETURN t1.text, t2.retweet_count, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets contain 'trump' (case-insensitive) and reply to tweets containing 'obama' (case-insensitive), where the original tweet has at least one favorite count?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'obama' AND t2.favorite_count > 0 RETURN t1.text, t2.favorite_count, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets contain the phrase 'shut up' (case-insensitive)?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'shut up' RETURN t1.text, t2.text

question: Which reply tweets contain the word 'idiot' (case-insensitive)?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'idiot' RETURN t1.text

question: Which hashtags are used in tweets with 30 favorites? Return the hashtag tag and favorite count.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t.favorite_count = 30 RETURN DISTINCT h.tag, t.favorite_count

question: Which reply tweets have zero favorites and zero retweets while the original tweet has engagement (i.e. non-zero favorites or retweets)?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE t1.favorite_count = 0 AND t1.retweet_count = 0 AND (t2.favorite_count > 0 OR t2.retweet_count > 0) RETURN t1.text, t2.text

question: Which tweets were posted via a source whose name contains 'Android'? Return the distinct source names.

question: Which tweets have more than 15 hashtags? Return the tweet text and the hashtag count.

question: How many 'HAS_TAG' relationships exist for hashtags whose tag contains 'fortrump'? Return the hashtag and the number of relationships.

question: How many 'HAS_TAG' relationships exist for hashtags whose tag contains 'hillary'? Return the number of relationships.

question: How many 'HAS_TAG' relationships exist for hashtags containing 'hillary' on tweets that have more than 5 hashtags? Return the number of relationships.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[r:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'hillary' AND COUNT { (t)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Hashtag) } > 5 RETURN COUNT(r) AS relCount

question: How many 'HAS_TAG' relationships exist for the hashtag 'trump' on tweets with more than 10 favorites? Return the number of relationships.

question: What is the average length of hashtags used in tweets? Return the average hashtag length.

question: Which hashtags appear in tweets with retweet number greater than 5000? Return the distinct hashtag tags and the tweet retweet number.

question: Which hashtags are used by tweets with more than 5000 retweet? Return distinct hashtag tags and tweet retweet number.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t.retweet_count > 5000 RETURN DISTINCT h.tag, t.retweet_count

question: Which tweets that have at least one hashtag have a retweet greater than 5000? Return retweet number, and number of hashtags.

question: Which tweets with at least five hashtags have a retweet number greater than favorite number? Return retweet number, favorite number, and number of hashtags.

question: Which tweets created in 2016 have more than 10 hashtags? Return creation string, and number of hashtags.

question: Which tweets with more than 155 characters have at least one hashtag? Return text length, and number of hashtags.

question: Which tweets have exactly three hashtags and retweet number greater than 500? Return the tweet id, retweet number, and number of hashtags.

question: Which tweets have more than 10 hashtags and retweet number equal to zero? Return the tweet id, retweet number, and number of hashtags.

question: Which tweets contain a '#' in the text but have zero 'HAS_TAG' relationships, and also have retweet number greater than 100? Return retweet number, and tweet text.

question: Which tweets have more than 11 hashtags, and every connected hashtag appears in the tweet text (case-insensitive)? Return tweet id and hashtag count.

question: Which tweets have a 'HAS_TAG' relationship to a hashtag whose tag length is exactly 30 characters, and also appears in the tweet text (case-insensitive)? Return the hashtag tag, and the tweet text.

question: Which tweets have at least one Cyrillic hashtag and at least one Latin-script hashtag? Return the tweet id and tweet text (possibly spanning multiple lines).

question: List the retweeting tweet text, retweeted tweet text, and both favorite number for retweets where the retweeted tweet contains 'idiot', 'hate', or 'dumb' (all case-insensitive), contains '!', and has more favorites than the retweeting tweet.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE t1.favorite_count < t2.favorite_count AND (toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'idiot' OR toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'hate' OR toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'dumb') AND t2.text CONTAINS '!' RETURN DISTINCT t1.text, t2.text, t1.favorite_count, t2.favorite_count

question: How many 'RETWEETED' relationships exist in the graph?

question: How many distinct tweets retweeted another tweet?

question: How many distinct tweets were retweeted by at least one other tweet?

question: What is the average favorite number of tweets that were retweeted?

question: How many retweets happened where retweeting and retweeted tweets have the same creation day?

question: How many retweets involve an original tweet whose text contains 'Obama'?

question: How many distinct URLs containing the string 'news' are linked in tweets?

question: What are the three most linked URLs that contain the string 'news', ordered alphabetically in case of ties?

question: What are the three shortest non-empty URLs linked in tweets that are not composed only of numbers, ordered alphabetically in case of ties?
cypher: MATCH (:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(u:URL) WHERE u.expanded_url <> '' AND NOT u.expanded_url =~ '^[0-9]+$' RETURN DISTINCT u.expanded_url AS url ORDER BY SIZE(url) ASC, url ASC LIMIT 3

question: Find trolls who posted tweets longer than 120 characters that contain 'obama' (case-insensitive), have at least one link, and received between 5 and 15 retweets. cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 120 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'obama' AND t.retweet_count >= 5 AND t.retweet_count <= 15 RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.time_zone, t.created_str, t.retweet_count, t.favorite_count, url.expanded_url, t.text

question: Identify trolls who posted tweets longer than 140 characters in 2016 that contain 'putin' (case-insensitive) and have a link. Return the troll screen name, troll location, tweet creation string, retweet number, favorite number, URL expanded url, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 140 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'putin' AND substring(t.created_str,0,4) = '2016' RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.location, t.created_str, t.retweet_count, t.favorite_count, url.expanded_url, t.text

question: Which trolls posted tweets longer than 120 characters that contain both 'election' and 'vote' (case-insensitive), have at least one link, and received more than 10 retweets? Return the troll screen name, troll time zone, tweet creation string, retweet number, favorite number, URL expanded url, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 120 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'vote' AND t.retweet_count > 10 RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.time_zone, t.created_str, t.retweet_count, t.favorite_count, url.expanded_url, t.text

question: Identify trolls who posted tweets longer than 130 characters that contain 'trump' (case-insensitive), include a link, and received more than 5000 retweets. Return the troll screen name, troll time zone, tweet creation string, retweet number, favorite number, URL expanded url, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 130 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND t.retweet_count > 5000 RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.time_zone, t.created_str, t.retweet_count, t.favorite_count, url.expanded_url, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find trolls who posted tweets with at least one link, longer than 130 characters, that mention either 'brexit' or 'referendum' but do not mention 'eu'. Return troll screen name, retweet number, and expanded URL, ordered by retweet number in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 130 AND (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'brexit' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'referendum') AND NOT toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'eu' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.retweet_count, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find trolls whose time zone is 'Baku' and who posted tweets containing '@realDonaldTrump' with a non-empty expanded URL. Return the troll screen name, tweet creation string, and expanded URL, ordered by tweet creation string in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE tr.time_zone = 'Baku' AND t.text CONTAINS '@realDonaldTrump' AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.created_str, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find trolls with screen names longer than 14 characters who posted tweets containing 'patriot' (case-insensitive) and have a non-empty expanded URL. Return screen name, retweet number, and expanded URL, ordered by retweet number in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(tr.screen_name) > 14 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'patriot' AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.retweet_count, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find trolls whose profile description includes the exact substring ' mom ' and contains exactly one hashtag (#...) in the description, and whose tweeted link URL is not empty. Return screen name, description, and expanded URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE tr.description IS NOT NULL AND tr.description <> '' AND tr.description CONTAINS ' mom ' AND tr.description =~ '^(?s)(?:[^#]*#){1}[^#]*$' AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.description, url.expanded_url

question: Find trolls who posted tweets containing a dollar amount ($) and 'budget' in the text and have a non-empty expanded URL link. Return screen name, time, and URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'budget' AND t.text =~ '.*\$\d+(\.\d{1,2})?.*' AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.created_str, url.expanded_url,t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find trolls whose text of the tweets contain a percentage and have at least one like, with a non-empty expanded URL link. Return time zone, favorite number, and URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t.text =~ '.*\d+(\.\d+)?%.*' AND t.favorite_count > 0 AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.time_zone, t.favorite_count, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.favorite_count DESC

question: Find trolls whose text of the tweets mention a year from 2016 to 2019, have more than 10 retweets, and have a non-empty expanded URL link. Return screen name, retweets, and URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t.text =~ '.*\b201[6-9]\b.*' AND t.retweet_count > 10 AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.retweet_count, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find trolls whose text of the tweets contain a number followed by k (like 10k), and have a non-empty expanded URL. Return location, time, and URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE toLower(t.text) =~ '.*\b\d+\s?k\b.*' AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.location, t.created_str, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find trolls who posted tweets more than 150 characters containing a hashtag-number pattern like #1 or #2020, and have a non-empty expanded URL link. Return screen name, time, and URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 150 AND t.text =~ '.*#\d+.*' AND url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, t.created_str, url.expanded_url ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find trolls who linked to a non-empty URL that is not twitter or youtube (case-insensitive), and whose tweet text contains 'kremlin' or 'кремль' (case-insensitive). Return troll screen name, location, and URL and text of tweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE url.expanded_url IS NOT NULL AND url.expanded_url <> '' AND NOT toLower(url.expanded_url) CONTAINS 'twitter.com' AND NOT toLower(url.expanded_url) CONTAINS 'youtube' AND ( toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'kremlin' OR toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'кремль' ) RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.location, url.expanded_url,t.text

question: Show troll tweets that has link and url length is more than 400 characters. Return troll name, tweet time, URL length, and the URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE SIZE(url.expanded_url) > 400 RETURN tr.screen_name, t.created_str, SIZE(url.expanded_url) AS url_len, url.expanded_url

question: Find trolls whose screen name has a length greater than 14 characters, posted tweets containing the word 'patriot' (case-insensitive), and whose linked expanded URL is longer than 100 characters. Return the troll screen name, the length of the screen name, the length of the expanded URL, and the expanded URL, ordered by URL length in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE tr.screen_name IS NOT NULL AND SIZE(tr.screen_name) > 14 AND SIZE(url.expanded_url) > 100 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'patriot' RETURN tr.screen_name, SIZE(tr.screen_name) AS name_len, SIZE(url.expanded_url) AS url_len, url.expanded_url ORDER BY url_len DESC

question: Find trolls whose time zone is 'Berlin' and who posted tweets containing a link where the expanded URL is longer than 200 characters. Return the troll screen name and the expanded URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE tr.time_zone = 'Berlin' AND SIZE(url.expanded_url) > 200 RETURN tr.screen_name, url.expanded_url

question: Show which users are mentioned the most. For each mentioned user, count how many distinct tweets mention that user, and order the results by mention_tweets in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u <> m RETURN m.screen_name AS mentioned_user, COUNT(DISTINCT t) AS mention_tweets ORDER BY mention_tweets DESC

question: Find long tweets (longer than 150 characters) whose text contains the word 'election' and that mention a user. Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text, ordered from newest to oldest.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 150 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'election' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find tweets that contain Cyrillic characters and that mention a user. Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the posting user's language tag, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE t.text =~ '.*[А-Яа-яЁё].*' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, u.lang, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets that mention a user and talk about 'ukraine' (case-insensitive), but exclude tweets that also mention 'Trump' (case-insensitive). Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE (toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'ukraine') AND NOT toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users whose screen name contains at least one digit, where the tweet text also contains at least one digit, and the tweet mentions a user whose screen name contains at least one digit. Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u.screen_name =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND t.text =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND m.screen_name =~ '.*[0-9].*' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users whose time zone contains 'US' (case-insensitive), where the tweet text contains the phrase 'rigged election' (case-insensitive), and the tweet mentions a user. Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE toLower(u.time_zone) CONTAINS 'us' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'rigged election' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users whose time zone contains 'US' (case-insensitive), where the tweet text contains 'rigged election' (case-insensitive) but does not contain 'trump' (case-insensitive), and the tweet mentions a user. Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE toLower(u.time_zone) CONTAINS 'us' AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'rigged election' AND NOT toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'trump' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find users who mention the account with screen name 'RealTEN_GOP'. Return the user screen name and the number of distinct tweets mentioning 'RealTEN_GOP', ordered by mention count in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE m.screen_name = 'RealTEN_GOP' RETURN u.screen_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t) AS mention_count ORDER BY mention_count DESC

question: Find tweets from November of 2016 that mention the user with screen name 'TEN_GOP'. Return screen name of user, creation string, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE m.screen_name = 'TEN_GOP' AND t.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11' RETURN u.screen_name, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a user and contain the phrase 'shut up' (case-insensitive). Return the author's screen name, the mentioned user's user key, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'shut up' RETURN u.screen_name, m.user_key AS mentioned_user_key, t.text

question: Count the number of distinct tweets posted by users that mention a user whose screen name property is missing (NULL). Return the total number of such tweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE m.screen_name IS NULL RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT t)

question: Find tweets posted by users who have zero followers that mention a user whose location property is missing (NULL). Return the posting user's screen name, the mentioned user's user key, and the tweet creation string.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE m.location IS NULL AND u.followers_count = 0 RETURN u.screen_name, m.user_key AS mentioned_user_key, t.created_str

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a user whose screen name is not NULL and whose text contains the word 'hate' (case-insensitive). Return the user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, and the tweet text, ordered by retweet number in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hate' AND m.screen_name IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a user and whose text contains 'stupid' (case-insensitive), where the mentioned user has more than 10 friends. Return the user's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, and the tweet text, ordered by favorite number in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'stupid' AND m.friends_count > 10 RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name, t.text ORDER BY t.favorite_count DESC

question: Find tweets longer than 145 characters that mention a user and whose text contains 'hate' (case-insensitive). Return the author's screen name, the mentioned user's user key, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 145 AND toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hate' RETURN u.screen_name, m.user_key AS mentioned_user_key, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets that mention a user (non-null screen name) and whose text contains 'hate' but do not contain 'sorry' (case-insensitive). Return author, mentioned user, created time, and text, sorted by most retweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'hate' AND NOT toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'sorry' AND m.screen_name IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a user and whose text contains a percent sign (%) and also includes a dollar amount like '$123'. Return the author's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '%' AND t.text =~ '.*\$[0-9]+.*' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find English-language users' tweets that mention a user, whose text contains the word 'WATCH', and where the mentioned user's time zone includes 'US'. Return the author's screen name, the mentioned user's screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'WATCH' AND u.lang = 'en' AND m.time_zone CONTAINS 'US' RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets whose text contains the word 'racist' where the author and the mentioned user have the same screen name (a self-mention or data anomaly). Return the author’s screen name, mentioned screen name, author language, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'racist' AND u.screen_name = m.screen_name RETURN u.screen_name, m.screen_name AS mentioned, u.lang, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by the user with screen name 'gloed_up' that mention a user whose screen name differs from 'gloed_up'. Return the mentioned user's screen name, the author's language, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u.screen_name = 'gloed_up' AND NOT m.screen_name = 'gloed_up' RETURN m.screen_name AS mentioned, u.lang, t.text

question: Find mention tweets posted by users that have at least 20 favorites but 5 or fewer retweets, where the mentioned user is not a Troll. Return the author’s screen name, the mentioned user’s user key, the tweet’s favorite number, the tweet’s retweet number, and the tweet text
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE NOT m:Troll AND t.favorite_count >= 20 AND t.retweet_count <= 5 RETURN u.screen_name, m.user_key AS mentioned, t.favorite_count, t.retweet_count, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users who mention a user whose follower number is at least fifteen times greater than the author's follower number. Return the author's screen name and follower number, the mentioned user's screen name and follower number, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND m.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND m.followers_count >= 15 * u.followers_count RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers_count, m.screen_name AS mentioned, m.followers_count, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users who mention a user whose follower number is at least fifty times greater than the author's follower number. Return the author's screen name and follower number, the mentioned user's screen name and follower count, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND m.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND m.followers_count >= 50 * u.followers_count RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers_count, m.screen_name AS mentioned, m.followers_count, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users with zero followers but more than 100 posted statuses that mention a user. Return the user screen name, status count, and mentioned user's user_key.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u.followers_count = 0 AND u.statuses_count > 100 RETURN u.screen_name, u.statuses_count, m.user_key AS mentioned

question: Find users who have more than 30,000 followers and more than 100 statuses and posted tweets mentioning a user. Return the user screen name and status count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE u.followers_count > 30000 AND u.statuses_count > 100 RETURN DISTINCT u.screen_name, u.statuses_count

question: Count how many distinct tweets posted by users mention a troll. Return the total number of such tweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT t) AS times

question: Find user tweets that mention a troll and also include '@realDonaldTrump' in the tweet text. Return screen name of user, screen name of the mentioned troll, creation string, and tweet text, sorted by highest retweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '@realDonaldTrump' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and have more than 20 retweets. Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, retweet count, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.retweet_count > 20 RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.retweet_count, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and contain the word 'ENOUGH' in uppercase. Return the user’s screen name, the mentioned troll’s screen name, the creation string, and the tweet text, ordered from newest to oldest.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'ENOUGH' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and contain three consecutive exclamation marks ('!!!'). Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, creation string, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '!!!' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and contain a hashtag symbol of POTUS ('#POTUS'). Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, and tweet text, sorted by highest retweet count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '#POTUS' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll whose screen name is longer than 14 characters. Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, and tweet creation string.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE SIZE(tr.screen_name) > 14 RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.created_str

question: Find tweets posted by a user that mention a Troll whose screen name is the same as the user’s screen name, where the tweet text contains 'https' and the user has more than 20,000 followers. Return the user’s screen name, the tweet text, and the user’s followers count.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE u.screen_name = tr.screen_name AND t.text CONTAINS 'https' AND u.followers_count > 20000 RETURN u.screen_name, t.text, u.followers_count

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and have more than 200 favorites. Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, favorite count, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.favorite_count > 200 RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.favorite_count, t.text

question: Find tweets created in 2016 by users whose location contains 'Atlanta' that mention a troll. Return the user’s location, the user’s screen name, the mentioned troll’s screen name, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.created_str CONTAINS '2016' AND u.location CONTAINS 'Atlanta' RETURN u.location,u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and contain a dollar sign ('$'). Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '$' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll whose language is set to Russian 'ru'. Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE tr.lang = 'ru' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and whose text contains the word 'why' (case-insensitive). Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'why' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention trolls with more than 50000 followers. Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, troll follower count, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE tr.followers_count > 50000 RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, tr.followers_count, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll and contain the word 'fake' (case-insensitive). Return the user’s screen name, mentioned troll’s screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE toLower(t.text) CONTAINS 'fake' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll, whose text contains at least one digit, and also include the laughing emoji (Unicode 😂). Return the user’s screen name, the mentioned troll’s user_key, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND t.text CONTAINS '😂' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.user_key AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by users that mention a troll, whose text contains the punctuation sequence '?!', and also include an angry emoji (Unicode 😡). Return the user’s screen name, the mentioned troll’s screen name, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '?!' AND t.text CONTAINS '😡' RETURN u.screen_name, tr.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets where a user mentions a troll with a different screen name than the user, the troll’s description contains '#Blacktivist', and both the user and the troll have language set to English. Return the user’s screen name, the tweet text, and the troll’s description.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll) WHERE NOT u.screen_name = tr.screen_name AND tr.description CONTAINS '#Blacktivist' AND u.lang = 'en' AND tr.lang = 'en' RETURN u.screen_name, t.text, tr.description

question: Count how many distinct tweets posted by trolls mention a user. Return the total number of such tweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT t)

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user and have more than 1000 retweets. Return the troll’s screen name, the mentioned user’s screen name, retweet count, and tweet text, sorted by highest retweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.retweet_count > 1000 RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.retweet_count, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets from 2016 posted by trolls that mention a user and whose text contains either 'DESTROYS' or 'BREAKING'. Include only tweets longer than 120 characters with more than 50 retweets. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, creation string, retweet count, and tweet text, sorted by highest retweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.created_str CONTAINS '2016' AND (t.text CONTAINS 'DESTROYS' OR t.text CONTAINS 'BREAKING') AND SIZE(t.text) > 120 AND t.retweet_count > 50 RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.created_str, t.retweet_count, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that are longer than 150 characters, mention a user, and contain more than one '@' character in the tweet text. Return the Troll’s screen name, the mentioned User’s user_key, and the tweet text
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE SIZE(t.text) > 150 AND SIZE([c IN SPLIT(t.text, '@') | c]) > 2 RETURN tr.screen_name, u.user_key AS mentioned_user, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user and contain both a percent sign ('%') and a dollar amount('$'). Return troll screen name, mentioned user user key, creation string, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '%' AND t.text =~ '.*\\$[0-9]+.*' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.user_key AS mentioned_user, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention users who have at least 20 times as many followers as the troll. Return troll and user follower counts,troll and user screen name and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE tr.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND u.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND u.followers_count >= 20 * tr.followers_count RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.followers_count, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, u.followers_count, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user, whose text contains '!!!', and have more than 200 retweets. Return troll screen name, mentioned user, retweets, and tweet text sorted by retweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS '!!!' AND t.retweet_count > 200 RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.retweet_count, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that are longer than 150 characters, mention a user and include 'http' in the text. Return troll screen name, mentioned user, creation string, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'http' AND SIZE(t.text) > 150 RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.created_str, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user and whose text contains 'CRIMINAL' as well as at least one numeric digit. Return troll screen name, mentioned user user key, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'CRIMINAL' AND t.text =~ '.*[0-9].*' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.user_key AS mentioned_user, t.text

question: Count how many distinct tweets posted by trolls mention a user whose location property is missing (NULL). Return the total number of such tweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE u.location IS NULL RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT t)

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention users located in ['Washington, DC','Atlanta, Georgia','Pittsburgh']. Return the troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, the user location, tweet creation string, and tweet text, sorted by highest retweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE u.location IN ['Washington, DC','Atlanta, Georgia','Pittsburgh'] RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, u.location, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by trolls whose time zone is not empty and does not contain 'US', where the tweet mentions a user whose time zone is also non-empty , and where the troll’s time zone differs from the mentioned user’s time zone. Return the troll’s screen name and time zone, the mentioned user’s screen name and time zone, the tweet creation string, and the tweet text, ordered from newest to oldest.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE tr.time_zone IS NOT NULL AND tr.time_zone <> '' AND NOT tr.time_zone CONTAINS 'US' AND u.time_zone IS NOT NULL AND u.time_zone <> '' AND tr.time_zone <> u.time_zone RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.time_zone AS troll_tz, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, u.time_zone AS user_tz, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find the time zone of the user with screen name 'WhiteHouseCards' who is mentioned in tweets posted by trolls. Return the user time zone.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE u.screen_name = 'WhiteHouseCards' RETURN DISTINCT u.time_zone

question: Find tweets posted by trolls whose location is 'Калуга, Россия' that mention a user. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE tr.location = 'Калуга, Россия' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls whose time zone is 'Volgograd' that mention a user and whose text contains 'Iran'. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, tweet creation string, and tweet text ordered from newest to oldest.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE tr.time_zone = 'Volgograd' AND t.text CONTAINS 'Iran' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user and contain Cyrillic characters. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, creation string, and tweet text ordered from newest to oldest.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text =~ '.*[А-Яа-яЁё].*' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY t.created_str DESC

question: Find tweets posted by trolls whose screen name contains 'patriot' (case-insensitive) that mention a user and contain the text 'RT @'. Return distinct troll screen name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'RT @' AND toLower(tr.screen_name) CONTAINS 'patriot' RETURN DISTINCT tr.screen_name

question: Find tweets posted by trolls whose screen name contains 'patriot' that mention a user and have more than 10 retweets. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, retweet count, and tweet text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls in the 'Volgograd' time zone that mention users with more than 5000 followers. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, follower count, and tweet text.

question: Find tweets longer than 120 characters posted by trolls located in 'Калуга, Россия' that mention a user. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, creation string, and tweet text.

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user and contain both digits and Cyrillic characters. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND t.text =~ '.*[А-Яа-яЁё].*' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by trolls located in 'Калуга, Россия' that mention users located in 'Washington, DC'. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, and tweet text.

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention users who share the same location as the troll and the location is not empty or null. Return the distinct shared location.

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention users who share the same time zone as the troll and the time zone is not empty or null. Return the distinct shared time zone.

question: Find tweets posted by trolls that mention a user and contain both 'RT @' and 'WARNING'. Return troll screen name, mentioned user screen name, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'RT @' AND t.text CONTAINS 'WARNING' RETURN tr.screen_name, u.screen_name AS mentioned_user, t.text

question: Count how many distinct tweets posted by trolls mention a troll. Return the total number of such tweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT t)

question: Find trolls that mention a troll with the same screen name as the posting troll (self-mention). Return the distinct troll screen name.

question: Find troll-to-troll mention tweets (troll post tweet that mention troll) that have more than 200 retweets. Return both trolls’ screen names, retweet count, and tweet text sorted by highest retweets.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE t.retweet_count > 200 RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.retweet_count, t.text ORDER BY t.retweet_count DESC

question: Find tweets where both the posting troll and the mentioned troll (troll post tweet that mention troll) have digits in their screen names . Return both screen names and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE tr1.screen_name =~ '.*[0-9].*' AND tr2.screen_name =~ '.*[0-9].*' RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Identify tweets posted by a Russian-language Troll that mention another Russian-language Troll. Return both screen names and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE tr1.lang = 'ru' AND tr2.lang = 'ru' RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets where a Troll posts a tweet that mentions another Troll, and the posting Troll has at least 10 times as many followers as the mentioned Troll. Return both Trolls’ screen names, both follower counts, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE tr1.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND tr2.followers_count IS NOT NULL AND tr1.followers_count >= 10 * tr2.followers_count RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr1.followers_count, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, tr2.followers_count, t.text

question: Find tweets where a troll mentions a troll and the tweet contains 'https', the posting troll has more followers than the mentioned troll, and the mentioned troll has more than 12000 followers. Return both trolls' screen names, both follower counts, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'https' AND tr1.followers_count > tr2.followers_count AND tr2.followers_count > 12000 RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr1.followers_count, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, tr2.followers_count, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by the troll with screen name 'JmsCoxxx' that mention a troll, where both trolls share the same non-null time zone and the tweet contains 'RT @'. Return the mentioned troll's screen name, the shared time zone, and the tweet text.

question: Find tweets posted by a troll that mention a troll and whose text contains the word 'war' (case-insensitive). Return the posting troll's screen name, the mentioned troll's screen name, and the tweet text.

question: Find tweets posted by a troll that mention a troll, where both trolls have the same non-empty location and are not the same account (different screen names). Return the posting troll's screen name, the shared location, the mentioned troll's screen name, and the tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE tr1.location IS NOT NULL AND tr1.location <> '' AND tr1.location = tr2.location AND NOT tr1.screen_name = tr2.screen_name RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr1.location, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by a troll that mention a troll whose listed count is at least 10 times greater than the posting troll's listed count. Return both trolls' screen names, both listed counts, the creation string, and the tweet text, ordered by the mentioned troll's listed count in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE tr1.listed_count IS NOT NULL AND tr2.listed_count IS NOT NULL AND tr2.listed_count >= 10 * tr1.listed_count RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr1.listed_count, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, tr2.listed_count, t.created_str, t.text ORDER BY tr2.listed_count DESC

question: Find tweets posted by a highly-listed troll (listed count more than 500) that mentions another highly-listed troll (listed count more than 500). Return both trolls’ screen names, both listed counts, and the tweet text.

question: Find tweets where a troll with very low listed count (under 10) mentions a troll with listed count over 30. Return both screen names, both listed counts, and the tweet text, sorted by the mentioned troll’s listed count.

question: Find tweets posted by a troll that mention a different troll and both trolls have the exact same listed count. Return the posting troll, listed count, mentioned troll, and tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr2:Troll) WHERE tr1.listed_count IS NOT NULL AND tr2.listed_count IS NOT NULL AND tr1.listed_count = tr2.listed_count AND tr1.screen_name <> tr2.screen_name RETURN tr1.screen_name, tr1.listed_count, tr2.screen_name AS mentioned_troll, t.text

question: Find tweets posted by the troll with screen name 'MarissaImStrong' that mention a troll. Return the posting troll's screen name, the mentioned troll's screen name, and the tweet text.

question: How many distinct tweets are retweets of original tweets that were posted by users? Return the total number of distinct retweet tweets.

question: Find tweets posted by users that have more than 4,000 retweets and were retweeted by tweets. Return the user's screen name, the original tweet's retweet count, and the original tweet text, ordered by retweet count in descending order.

question: Identify tweets that retweet original tweets posted by users, where the original tweet text exceeds 145 characters. Return the original author’s screen name and the original tweet text

question: Find retweets of user-posted tweets with more than 4,000 favorites. Return the user’s screen name, favorite count, and original tweet text sorted by highest favorites.

question: Find retweets of User-posted tweets where the user has more than 60,000 followers. Return the user’s screen name, follower count, and original tweet text sorted by follower count.

question: Find retweets of User-posted tweets where the user has more than 25000 friends. Return the user’s screen name, friends_count and their classification Labels and original tweet text sorted by friends_count.

question: Find retweets of tweets posted by users whose text contains '?!!'. Return the user’s screen name and original tweet text.

question: Find retweets of tweets posted by users that have more than 2,000 retweets and more than 2,000 favorites. Return user screen name, retweet count, favorite count, and original tweet text sorted by retweets.

question: Find retweets of tweets posted by users whose text contains 'BREAKING' and at least one digit. Return the user’s screen name and original tweet text.

question: Find users who posted tweets that were retweeted, where the original tweet was created in November 2016 and whose text contains 'Election' . Return the user’s screen name, the original tweet’s creation string, the original tweet text, and the user’s labels.

question: Find retweets of tweets posted by users located in 'Atlanta, Georgia'. Return the user’s screen name, and original tweet text.

question: Identify tweets posted by a user whose location is 'Washington, DC' that were retweeted, and where the retweeting tweet contains the hashtag '#RejectedDebate'. Return the original poster’s screen name and the original tweet text.

question: Find tweets that reply to troll-posted tweets where the troll location is not empty or missing. Return troll screen name, location, and reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(tr:Troll) WHERE tr.location IS NOT NULL AND tr.location <> '' RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.location, t1.text

question: Find rtweets that reply to troll tweets where the troll’s screen name contains an underscore. Return troll screen name and reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(tr:Troll) WHERE tr.screen_name CONTAINS '_' RETURN tr.screen_name, t1.text

question: Find tweets whose text mentions 'trump' (case-insensitive) in reply to an original troll-posted tweet that does not contain that term. Return troll screen name, original text, and reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(tr:Troll) WHERE toLower(t1.text) CONTAINS 'trump' AND NOT toLower(t2.text) CONTAINS 'trump' RETURN tr.screen_name, t2.text AS original_text, t1.text AS reply_text

question: Find tweets that reply to troll-posted tweets where both the original tweet and the reply text include the substring 'http'. Return troll screen name and both original and reply texts.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(tr:Troll) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS 'http' AND t2.text CONTAINS 'http' RETURN tr.screen_name, t2.text AS original_text, t1.text AS reply_text

question: Find tweets that reply to user-posted tweets where the reply tweet and the original tweet were created on the same calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Return the user screen name, the original tweet’s created string, the reply tweet’s created string, the original text, and the reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(u:User) WHERE SUBSTRING(t1.created_str,0,10) = SUBSTRING(t2.created_str,0,10) RETURN u.screen_name, t2.created_str, t1.created_str, t2.text AS original_text, t1.text AS reply_text

question: Find tweets that reply to troll-posted tweets where the reply tweet and the original tweet were created on the same calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Return the troll screen name, the original tweet’s created string, the reply tweet’s created string, the original text, and the reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(tr:Troll) WHERE SUBSTRING(t1.created_str,0,10) = SUBSTRING(t2.created_str,0,10) RETURN tr.screen_name, t2.created_str, t1.created_str, t2.text AS original_text, t1.text AS reply_text

question: Find tweets that reply to user-posted tweets where the original tweet was created between '2016-08-01' and '2016-10-31'. Return the user screen name, the original tweet creation string, the reply tweet creation string, the original text, and the reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(u:User) WHERE SUBSTRING(t2.created_str,0,10) >= '2016-08-01' AND SUBSTRING(t2.created_str,0,10) <= '2016-10-31' RETURN u.screen_name, t2.created_str, t1.created_str, t2.text AS original_text, t1.text AS reply_text

question: Find tweets that reply to troll-posted tweets where the original troll tweet was created between '2016-05-01' and '2016-07-31'. Return the troll screen name, the original tweet creation string, the reply tweet creation string, the original text, and the reply text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)<-[:POSTED]-(tr:Troll) WHERE SUBSTRING(t2.created_str,0,10) >= '2016-05-01' AND SUBSTRING(t2.created_str,0,10) <= '2016-07-31' RETURN tr.screen_name, t2.created_str, t1.created_str, t2.text AS original_text, t1.text AS reply_text

question: For retweets of tweets that have the hashtag 'oscarssowhite', return the retweet text and the number of tag relationships associated with the original tweet.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[r:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'oscarssowhite'}) RETURN t1.text AS retweet_text, COUNT(r) AS hashtag_count

question: For hashtags whose tag contains the substring 'oscar', return each distinct hashtag and the number of retweet relationships associated with tweets having that hashtag.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'oscar' RETURN DISTINCT h.tag AS hashtag, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count

question: For retweets of tweets that have at least one hashtag whose tag contains either 'white' or 'black', return each distinct hashtag and the number of tag relationships associated with tweets containing those hashtags.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[r:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'white' OR h.tag CONTAINS 'black' RETURN DISTINCT h.tag AS hashtag, COUNT(r) AS hashtag_count

question: For retweets of tweets that have the hashtag 'thingsyoucantignore', return each distinct retweet text and its retweet count.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'thingsyoucantignore'}) RETURN DISTINCT t1.text AS retweet_text, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count

question: Return the full set of properties for retweet tweets that retweeted tweets having a hashtag whose tag includes 'mondaymotivation'.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'mondaymotivation' RETURN properties(t1) AS retweet_properties

question: Find the tweet texts that contain 'cnnbrk' and retweet tweets that do not have any associated hashtags.Return each distinct retweet text.

question: What distinct hashtags containing the word 'hillary' do retweeted tweets have?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'hillary' RETURN DISTINCT h.tag AS hashtag

question: Show the different hashtags whose tag contains the substring 'never', and for each one, return how many retweet relationships point to tweets that have that hashtag, ordered from highest to lowest count.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'never' RETURN h.tag AS hashtag, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count ORDER BY retweet_count DESC

question: Show the different hashtags whose tag contains the substring 'for', and for each one, return how many retweet relationships point to tweets that have that hashtag, ordered from highest to lowest count.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'for' RETURN h.tag AS hashtag, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count ORDER BY retweet_count DESC

question: Find hashtags containing 'for' or '4' in tweets that were retweeted. Return each hashtag and the number of times it appears in retweeted tweets, ordered by count in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[r:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS 'for' OR h.tag CONTAINS '4' RETURN h.tag AS hashtag, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count ORDER BY retweet_count DESC

question: For retweets of tweets that have the hashtag 'guns4ny', return the retweet text and how many retweet relationships correspond to that retweet text, ordered from most to least.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'guns4ny'}) RETURN t1.text AS retweet_text, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count ORDER BY retweet_count DESC

question: What are the texts of tweets that have any relationship to tweets having the hashtag 'guns4ny'?
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'guns4ny'}) RETURN t1.text AS tweet_text

question: For tweets that have any type of relationship to tweets having the hashtag 'guns4ny', return the tweet text and the type of relationship between the two tweets.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'guns4ny'}) RETURN t1.text AS tweet_text, TYPE(r) AS relationship_type

question: For retweets whose text contains 'Paul Van' and that retweet tweets having hashtags, return the retweet text, the retweet creation time, and the associated hashtag tag.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS 'Paul Van' RETURN t1.text AS retweet_text, t1.created_str AS created_time, h.tag AS hashtag

question: For retweets of tweets having the hashtag 'trumpsfavoriteheadline' that were created on '2016-08-17', return each distinct retweet text and the number of times it was retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'trumpsfavoriteheadline'}) WHERE t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016-08-17' RETURN DISTINCT t1.text AS retweet_text, COUNT(r) AS retweet_count

question: For retweets of tweets having the hashtag 'igetdepressedwhen', return each distinct retweet creation timestamp.

question: For retweets of tweets having the hashtag 'reallifemagicspells' that were created on '2016-11-14', return the number of distinct retweets.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag {tag:'reallifemagicspells'}) WHERE t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11-14' RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT t1) AS distinct_retweet_count

question: Find retweets of tweets that have at least one hashtag and were created on '2016-11-14'. Return the distinct hashtags of the tweets they retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016-11-14' RETURN DISTINCT h.tag AS hashtag

question: Find retweets of tweets that have at least one hashtag and were created between '2016-11' and '2016-12'. Return the distinct hashtags of the tweets they retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t1.created_str > '2016-11' AND t1.created_str < '2016-12' RETURN DISTINCT h.tag AS hashtag

question: For retweets were created in '2016', return the number of distinct hashtags of the tweets they retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016' RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT h.tag) AS distinct_hashtag_count

question: For retweets not created in '2016' , return the number of distinct hashtags connected to the tweets they retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE NOT t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016' RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT h.tag) AS distinct_hashtag_count

question: For retweets  created in '2016' whose text contains '5)', return each distinct retweet text and the hashtag of the tweet they retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016' AND t1.text CONTAINS '5)' RETURN DISTINCT t1.text AS retweet_text, h.tag AS hashtag

question: For retweets whose text contains 'New York' and that retweeted tweets having a hashtag containing '4ny', return each distinct retweet text.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.tag CONTAINS '4ny' AND t1.text CONTAINS 'New York' RETURN DISTINCT t1.text AS retweet_text

question: For retweets of tweets whose text contains 'Washington post' and that have a hashtag, return each distinct retweet text, the original tweet text, and the hashtag.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t2.text CONTAINS 'Washington post' RETURN DISTINCT t1.text AS retweet_text, t2.text AS original_tweet_text, h.tag AS hashtag

question: For relationships between tweets where the second tweet has a hashtag, return each relationship type and the number of such relationships.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN TYPE(r) AS relationship_type, COUNT(r) AS relationship_count

question: For tweets that have the hashtag '2016electionin3words', return each distinct tweet text and the other hashtags that appear in the same tweet.

question: For tweets that have the hashtag 'hahahahaha', return the distinct other hashtags that co-occur in the same tweet.
cypher: MATCH (h1:Hashtag {tag:'hahahahaha'})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(t:Tweet)-[:HAS_TAG]->(h2:Hashtag) WHERE h1 <> h2 RETURN DISTINCT h2.tag AS co_occurring_hashtag

question: Return expanded URLs that contain 'video' and are linked to tweets that are replies to other tweets.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE url.expanded_url CONTAINS 'video' RETURN url.expanded_url AS expanded_url

question: For reply tweets (tweets that are in reply to another tweet) where the original tweet links to a URL whose expanded URL contains 'web', return the reply text and the expanded URL.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE url.expanded_url CONTAINS 'web' RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url

question: For reply tweets whose text contains 'Russia' or 'Syria', where the tweet they reply to links to a URL, return the reply text, the reply creation time, and the expanded URL.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS 'Russia' OR t1.text CONTAINS 'Syria' RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, t1.created_str AS created_time, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url

question: For replies to tweets that contain a URL link, return the reply text, the reply creation timestamp, and the expanded URL from the linked URL, ordered by the reply creation time ascending.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, t1.created_str AS reply_created_timestamp, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url ORDER BY t1.created_str ASC

question: Find replies to tweets that contain a URL link where the reply text contains 'NATO'. Return the reply text and the expanded URL.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS 'NATO' RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url

question: For replies to tweets that contain a URL link, return the reply text and the length of the expanded URL, ordered by URL length descending.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, SIZE(url.expanded_url) AS url_length ORDER BY url_length DESC

question: For replies to tweets that contain a URL link, return the reply text, the expanded URL, and the length of the reply text, ordered by reply text length descending.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url, SIZE(t1.text) AS reply_text_length ORDER BY reply_text_length DESC

question: For replies to tweets that contain a URL link, return the reply text, its favorite count, its retweet count, and the expanded URL, ordered by favorite count descending and then retweet count descending.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, t1.favorite_count AS favorite_count, t1.retweet_count AS retweet_count, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url ORDER BY t1.favorite_count DESC, t1.retweet_count DESC

question: Find replies to tweets that contain a URL link where the reply text contains 'Please RT'. Return the reply text, the reply retweet count, and the expanded URL, ordered by retweet count descending.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS 'Please RT' RETURN t1.text AS reply_text, t1.retweet_count AS retweet_count, url.expanded_url AS expanded_url ORDER BY t1.retweet_count DESC

question: Find replies to tweets that contain a URL link where the reply text contains 'Moscow' and the expanded URL also contains 'moscow'. Return the reply text and the expanded URL.

question: For relationships between tweets where the second tweet has a URL link, return each relationship type and how many such relationships exist.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) RETURN TYPE(r) AS relationship_type, COUNT(r) AS relationship_count

question: For relationships between tweets where the second tweet has a URL link, return each relationship type and how many URL nodes are linked for that relationship type.
cypher: MATCH (t1:Tweet)-[r]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) RETURN TYPE(r) AS relationship_type, COUNT(url) AS url_count

question: For replies to tweets that have a hashtag, return distinct reply texts, all properties of the hashtag node, and the internal element ID of the hashtag node.

question: Among replies to tweets that have a URL link, find replies whose text starts with 'https' and return the distinct reply text together with the expanded URL.

question: Among replies to tweets that have a URL link, return distinct replies created in 2016 where the expanded URL contains 'news', along with that expanded URL.

question: Find replies to tweets that have a hashtag where the reply date (first 10 characters of creation string) matches the original tweet date (first 10 characters). Return the reply text, the original tweet text, both timestamps, and the properties of the hashtag.

question: Find replies where the first 13 characters of the reply creation time match the first 13 characters of the original tweet creation time, and return the reply text, the original tweet text and both timestamps.

question: Find replies to tweets that have a hashtag where the first 13 characters of the reply creation time match the first 13 characters of the original tweet creation time. Return the reply text, original tweet text, both timestamps, and the hashtag tag.

question: For tweets that reply to another tweet having a URL link where the expanded URL contains 'medium', return the reply text, the original tweet text, both creation timestamps, and the expanded URL.

question: For reply tweets where the original tweet does not contain any URL link and the reply and the original tweet were created on the same year, month, day, and hour (by comparing the first 13 characters of each creation timestamp), return the reply text, the original tweet text, and both creation timestamps.

question: Find users who have an outgoing relationship to tweets that contain a URL whose expanded url includes the substring 'correctness'. Return the relationship type, the user user key, the tweet text, and the expanded URL.

question: Find tweets connected to the troll with user key 'trayneshacole' where the tweet also has an outgoing relationship back to the same Troll. Return the types of both relationships and the tweet text.

question: Find tweets connected to the troll with user key 'cascaseyp' that contain the substring 'Clinton ', and return the distinct tweet text along with the type of the relationship between the troll and the tweet, and the type of the outgoing relationship from the tweet to any node.
