question: Identify the user or troll account who posted a retweet in '2016-09' of a tweet mentioning a user or troll account. Return the posting account identifier and labels, the retweet creation string, the text of the retweeted tweet, and the mentioned account identifier and labels.
cypher: MATCH (a)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(b) WHERE (a:User OR a:Troll) AND (b:User OR b:Troll) AND t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016-09' RETURN CASE WHEN a:User THEN a.user_key ELSE a.screen_name END AS posting_account_identifier, LABELS(a), t1.created_str, t2.text, CASE WHEN b:User THEN b.user_key ELSE b.screen_name END AS mentioned_account_identifier, LABELS(b)

question: Show users who posted a retweet of a tweet that has the hashtag 'ihaveadreamthat', where the user's account creation string contains 'Wed' and the retweet was created in '2017'. Return the user screen name, the retweet creation string, and the retweeted tweet creation time.

question: Show the distinct pairs of tweet texts where a troll posted a tweet mentioning another troll, the mentioning tweet contains the hashtag '#BetterAlternativeToDebates' and includes a link ('http'), and the mentioned troll also posted a tweet containing the hashtag '#RejectedDebateTopics' and at least one digit. question: Highlight troll accounts whose screen name is 'WarfareWW' who posted a reply to a tweet that has a link, where the troll has more than 500 listed entries and more than 7000 friends. Return the troll listed count, their friends count, the creation date of the reply, and the link URL.

question: Identify troll accounts who posted a retweet in '2016-09' of a tweet mentioning a user and containing '#IfICouldntLie' in its text. Return the troll account user key, their followers count, the retweet creation string, and the text of the retweeted tweet.
cypher: MATCH (tr1:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u2:User) WHERE t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016-09' AND t2.text CONTAINS '#IfICouldntLie' RETURN tr1.user_key, tr1.followers_count, t1.created_str, t2.text

question: Identify troll accounts with more than 7000 friends who posted a retweet of a tweet replying to another tweet, where the retweeted tweet contains 'women rights' in its text. Return the troll screen name, their friends count, the retweet creation string, and the text of the retweeted tweet.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t3:Tweet) WHERE tr.friends_count > 7000 AND t2.text CONTAINS 'women rights' RETURN tr.screen_name, tr.friends_count, t1.created_str, t2.text

question: Find users or troll accounts who posted a retweet in '2016-08' of a tweet replying to another tweet and containing '@realDonaldTrump' in its text. Return the posting account screen name, the retweet creation string, and the text of the retweeted tweet.
cypher: MATCH (a)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t3:Tweet) WHERE (a:User OR a:Troll) AND t1.created_str CONTAINS '2016-08' AND t2.text CONTAINS '@realDonaldTrump' RETURN a.screen_name, t1.created_str, t2.text

question: Highlight troll accounts who posted a tweet containing 'Russia' that is connected by some outgoing relationship to another tweet that has a link whose expanded URL contains at least one digit. Return the troll screen name, both tweet texts, the relationship type, and the link URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[r]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS 'Russia' AND url.expanded_url =~ '.*[0-9].*' RETURN tr.screen_name, t1.text, t2.text, TYPE(r), url.expanded_url

question: Identify users with more than 9000 followers who posted a retweet of a tweet mentioning a user and containing both 'CENSORSHIP' and 'pro-Trump' in its text. Return the user's screen name, the retweet creation string, the text of the retweeted tweet, and their followers count.
cypher: MATCH (u1:User)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u2:User) WHERE u1.followers_count > 9000 AND t2.text CONTAINS 'CENSORSHIP' AND t2.text CONTAINS 'pro-Trump' RETURN u1.screen_name, t1.created_str, t2.text, u1.followers_count

question: Show trolls in the 'Nairobi' time zone whose location is 'Москва, Россия', where the troll posted a retweet of a tweet posted via some source, and the retweeted tweet text contains 'worst President EVER'. Return the retweet creation string, the text of the retweeted tweet, and the source name.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:POSTED_VIA]->(s:Source) WHERE tr.time_zone = 'Nairobi' AND tr.location = 'Москва, Россия' AND t2.text CONTAINS 'worst President EVER' RETURN t1.created_str, t2.text, s.name

question: Show trolls who posted a retweet of a tweet that has a link containing 'breitbart.com', where the retweeting tweet text contains both 'Washington Post' and 'Birther Movement'. Return the troll's screen name, the text of the retweeting tweet, the text of the retweeted tweet, and the URL.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETED]->(t2:Tweet)-[:HAS_LINK]->(url:URL) WHERE url.expanded_url CONTAINS 'breitbart.com' AND t1.text CONTAINS 'Washington Post' AND t1.text CONTAINS 'Birther Movement' RETURN tr.screen_name, t1.text, t2.text, url.expanded_url

question: Find troll accounts who posted a tweet connected by some outgoing relationship to another tweet whose text is longer than the posted tweet text, where that other tweet replies to another tweet. Return the troll screen name, the texts of the first two tweets in the chain, the relationship type, and the further tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[r]->(t2:Tweet)-[:IN_REPLY_TO]->(t3:Tweet) WHERE SIZE(t2.text) > SIZE(t1.text) RETURN tr.screen_name, t1.text, t2.text, TYPE(r), t3.text

question: Show the user-troll pairs where the user posted a tweet mentioning a troll, the user tweet text contains the collision emoji '💥' using Unicode ('💥'), and the troll tweet text contains 'WOW🚨' using the police-light emoji Unicode ('WOW🚨'). Return the user screen name, the user tweet text, the troll screen name, and the troll tweet text.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTED]->(t1:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(tr:Troll)-[:POSTED]->(t2:Tweet) WHERE t1.text CONTAINS '💥' AND t2.text CONTAINS 'WOW🚨' RETURN u.screen_name, t1.text, tr.screen_name, t2.text
